How to associate file to annotation dictionary?

```java
import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.DateTime;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.fxcrt.RectF;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.AssociatedFiles;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.FileSpec;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.annots.Annot;

class TestCase {

 public void testUint() {
 Library.initialize("sn", "key");
 try {
 //load document
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("sample.pdf");
 int error_code = doc.load(null);
 if (error_code != Constants.e_ErrSuccess) return;

 AssociatedFiles associated_files = new AssociatedFiles(doc);

 //Create filespec with 1.txt
 FileSpec filespec_txt =new FileSpec(doc);
 filespec_txt.setAssociteFileRelationship(AssociatedFiles.e_RelationshipSource);
 filespec_txt.setFileName("1.txt");
 DateTime dateTime = new DateTime(2023, 6, 8, 17, 20, 20, 0, (short) 8, 0);
 filespec_txt.setDescription("text");
 filespec_txt.embed("1.txt");
 filespec_txt.setCreationDateTime(dateTime);
 filespec_txt.setModifiedDateTime(dateTime);
 filespec_txt.setSubtype("application/octet-stream");

 PDFPage page = doc.getPage(0);
 RectF rect = new RectF(100, 50, 220, 100);
 Annot annot = page.addAnnot(Annot.e_Note, rect);
 annot.resetAppearanceStream();
 associated_files.associateFile(annot, filespec_txt);

 // Save PDF file
 String newPdf = "newpdf.pdf";
 doc.saveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}
```

---

Initialize Library It is necessary for applications to initialize Foxit PDF SDK before calling any APIs. The function com.foxit.sdk.common.Library#initialize is provided to initialize Foxit PDF SDK. A license should be purchased for the application and pass unlock key and code to get proper supports. When there is no need to use Foxit PDF SDK any more, please call function com.foxit.sdk.common.Library#Release to release it. Note The parameter "sn" can be found in the "rdk_sn.txt" (the string after "SN=") and the "key" can be found in the "rdk_key.txt" (the string after "Sign=").

```java

class TestCase {

 private static final String sn = "";
 private static final String key = "";

 public boolean testUint() {
 int error_code = Library.initialize(sn, key);
 return error_code != Constants.e_ErrSuccess;
 }
}

```

how to export fdf file

```java
import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Range;
import com.foxit.sdk.fdf.FDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage;

public class TestCase {
 private static final String TAG = TestCase.class.getSimpleName();

 public void testUint() {
 Library.initialize("sn", "key");
 try {
 //load document
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("AboutFoxit.pdf");
 int error_code = doc.load(null);
 if (error_code != Constants.e_ErrSuccess) return;

 //export all annots
 FDFDoc fdf_doc = new FDFDoc(FDFDoc.e_FDF);
 doc.exportToFDF(fdf_doc,PDFDoc.e_Annots, new Range());

 //export single annot
 PDFPage page = doc.getPage(0);
 if (page.getAnnotCount() > 0) {
 doc.exportAnnotToFDF(page.getAnnot(0),fdf_doc);
 }
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 Library.release();
 }

}
```

How to add a link annotation

```java
import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.fxcrt.RectF;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.actions.Action;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.actions.URIAction;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.annots.Annot;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.annots.Link;

class TestCase {

 public void testUint() {
 Library.initialize("sn", "key");
 try {
 //load document
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("sample.pdf");
 int error_code = doc.load(null);
 if (error_code != Constants.e_ErrSuccess) return;

 PDFPage page = doc.getPage(0);

 // Add link annotation
 Annot annot = page.addAnnot(Annot.e_Link, new RectF(350, 350, 380, 400));
 Link link = new Link(annot);
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 link.setFlags(4);
 link.setHighlightingMode(Annot.e_HighlightingPush);

 // Add action for link annotation
 Action action = Action.create(doc, Action.e_TypeURI);
 URIAction uriAction = new URIAction(action);
 uriAction.setTrackPositionFlag(true);
 uriAction.setURI("www.foxitsoftware.com");
 link.setAction(action);
 link.resetAppearanceStream();

 // Save PDF file
 String newPdf = "newpdf.pdf";
 doc.saveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}
```

---

How to associate file to marked content?

```java
import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.DateTime;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.AssociatedFiles;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.FileSpec;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.graphics.GraphicsObject;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.graphics.MarkedContent;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.objects.PDFDictionary;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.objects.PDFObject;

class TestCase {

 public void testUint() {

 Library.initialize("sn", "key");
 try {
 //load document
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("sample.pdf");
 int error_code = doc.load(null);
 if (error_code != Constants.e_ErrSuccess) return;

 AssociatedFiles associated_files = new AssociatedFiles(doc);
 FileSpec filespec_jpg = new FileSpec(doc);
 filespec_jpg.setAssociteFileRelationship(AssociatedFiles.e_RelationshipSource);
 filespec_jpg.setFileName("2.jpg");
 filespec_jpg.setDescription("jpeg");
 filespec_jpg.embed("2.jpg");
 DateTime dateTime = new DateTime(2017, 9, 15, 17, 20, 20, 0, (short) 8, 0);
 filespec_jpg.setCreationDateTime(dateTime);
 filespec_jpg.setModifiedDateTime(dateTime);
 filespec_jpg.setSubtype("application/octet-stream");
 PDFPage page = doc.getPage(0);
 page.startParse(PDFPage.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);
 PDFDictionary page_dict = page.getDict();
 PDFObject object = page_dict.getElement("Resources");
 PDFDictionary resource_dict = object.getDict();

 long position = page.getFirstGraphicsObjectPosition(GraphicsObject.e_TypeText);
 GraphicsObject text_object = page.getGraphicsObject(position);
 if (text_object != null) {
 MarkedContent markcontent = text_object.getMarkedContent();
 if (markcontent == null) return;
 if (markcontent.getItemCount() == 0) {
 markcontent.addItem("Associated", null);
 }
 associated_files.associateFile(text_object, 0, resource_dict, "textobject", filespec_jpg);
 page.generateContent();
 }

 // Save PDF file
 String newPdf = "newpdf.pdf";
 doc.saveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}

```

how to remove all header footer

import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.HeaderFooter;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;

import static com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants.e_ErrSuccess;
import static com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal;

public class Pdfheaderfooter {
 static String key = " ";
 static String sn = " ";

 public static void main(String[] args) throws PDFException {
 // Initialize library
 int error_code = Library.initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != e_ErrSuccess) {
 return ;
 }
 {
 PDFDoc pdfDoc = new PDFDoc("inputPath");
 pdfDoc.load(null);

 HeaderFooter headerfooter = pdfDoc.getEditableHeaderFooter();
 //Remove all header-footers
 pdfDoc.removeAllHeaderFooters();
 String output_file = "HeaderFooter_RemoveAll.pdf";
 pdfDoc.saveAs(output_file, e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}

How to open pdf document with Foxit PDF SDK for Android?

Foxit PDF SDK for Android provides multiple interfaces to open a PDF document. You can open a
PDF document from a specified PDF file path, or from a memory buffer. For from a specified PDF file
path, there are two ways to do that.

* The first one is that just use the openDoc interface, which includes the operations of creating a PDF
document object (PDFDoc(String path)), loading the document content (load), and setting the PDF
document object to view control (setDoc). Following is the sample code:

__Note__: The openDoc interface is only available for opening a PDF document from a file path. If you want to
customize to load a PDF document, you can implement it in the callback function __(FileRead)__, and then
create a document object with a FireRead instance using __PDFDoc(FileRead fileRead)__. Next, also load the
document content using __load__, and set the PDF document object to view control using __setDoc__.

```java
// Assuming A PDFViewCtrl has been created.
// Open an unencrypted PDF document from a specified PDF file path.
String path = "/mnt/sdcard/input_files/Sample.pdf";
pdfViewCtrl.openDoc(path, null);
```

* The second one is that use the PDFDoc(String path) interface to create a PDF document object , use
 load interface to load the document content, and then use setDoc to set the PDF document object to
 view control. Following is the sample code:

```java
String path = "/mnt/sdcard/input_files/Sample.pdf";
try {
 // Initialize a PDFDoc object with the path to the PDF file.
 PDFDoc document = new PDFDoc(path);
 // Load the unencrypted document content.
 document.load(null);
 // Set the document to view control.
 pdfViewCtrl.setDoc(document);
} catch (Exception e) {
 // TODO Auto-generated catch block
 e.printStackTrace();
}
```

---

How to remove bookmark?

```java
import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.Bookmark;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;

public class TestCase {

 public void testUint() {
 Library.initialize("sn", "key");
 try {
 //load document
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("AboutFoxit.pdf");
 int error_code = doc.load(null);
 if (error_code != Constants.e_ErrSuccess) return;

 //Get bookmark root node or Create new bookmark root node.
 Bookmark root = doc.getRootBookmark();
 // Get first bookmark and change properties.
 Bookmark first_bookmark = root.getFirstChild();
 if (!first_bookmark.getNextSibling().isEmpty()) {
 doc.removeBookmark(first_bookmark.getNextSibling());
 }
 // Save PDF file
 String newPdf = "bookmark_remove.pdf";
 doc.saveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}
```

how to add combo box

```java
import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.fxcrt.RectF;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.annots.Widget;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.interform.ChoiceOption;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.interform.ChoiceOptionArray;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.interform.Control;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.interform.Field;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.interform.Form;

public class TestCase {
 private static final String TAG = TestCase.class.getSimpleName();

 public void testUint() {
 Library.initialize("sn", "key");
 try {
 //load document
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("sample.pdf");
 int error_code = doc.load(null);
 if (error_code != Constants.e_ErrSuccess) return;

 Form form = new Form(doc);
 PDFPage page = doc.insertPage(0, PDFPage.e_SizeLetter);

 // Add combo box
 Control control = form.addControl(page, "Combo Box0", Field.e_TypeComboBox, new RectF(50, 350, 350, 400));

 Field field = control.getField();
 ChoiceOptionArray options = new ChoiceOptionArray();
 options.add(new ChoiceOption("Foxit SDK", "Foxit SDK", true, true));
 options.add(new ChoiceOption("Foxit Reader", "Foxit Reader", true, true));
 options.add(new ChoiceOption("Foxit Phantom", "Foxit Phantom", true, true));
 field.setOptions(options);

 Widget widget = control.getWidget();
 widget.setMKBorderColor(0x000000);
 widget.setMKBackgroundColor(0xFFFFFF);
 widget.resetAppearanceStream();

 // Save PDF file
 String newPdf = "newpdf.pdf";
 doc.saveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNormal);
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 Library.release();
 }

}
```

How to associate file to image object?

```java
import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.DateTime;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.AssociatedFiles;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.FileSpec;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.graphics.GraphicsObject;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.graphics.ImageObject;

class TestCase {

 public void testUint() {

 Library.initialize("sn", "key");
 try {
 //load document
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("sample.pdf");
 int error_code = doc.load(null);
 if (error_code != Constants.e_ErrSuccess) return;

 AssociatedFiles associated_files = new AssociatedFiles(doc);
 FileSpec filespec_jpg = new FileSpec(doc);
 filespec_jpg.setAssociteFileRelationship(AssociatedFiles.e_RelationshipSource);
 filespec_jpg.setFileName("2.jpg");
 filespec_jpg.setDescription("jpeg");
 filespec_jpg.embed("2.jpg");
 DateTime dateTime = new DateTime(2017, 9, 15, 17, 20, 20, 0, (short) 8, 0);
 filespec_jpg.setCreationDateTime(dateTime);
 filespec_jpg.setModifiedDateTime(dateTime);
 filespec_jpg.setSubtype("application/octet-stream");

 PDFPage page = doc.getPage(0);
 page.startParse(PDFPage.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);
 long position = page.getFirstGraphicsObjectPosition(GraphicsObject.e_TypeFormXObject);
 GraphicsObject graphics_object = page.getGraphicsObject(position);
 if (graphics_object != null) {
 ImageObject image_oject = graphics_object.getImageObject();
 if (image_oject != null)
 associated_files.associateFile(image_oject, filespec_jpg);
 }

 // Save PDF file
 String newPdf = "newpdf.pdf";
 doc.saveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}
```

---

how to update header footer

import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.HeaderFooter;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.HeaderFooterContent;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.HeaderFooterContentGenerator;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;

import static com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants.e_ErrSuccess;
import static com.foxit.sdk.pdf.HeaderFooterContentGenerator.e_DateFormatMSlashDSlashYYYY;
import static com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal;

public class Pdfheaderfooter {
 static String key = " ";
 static String sn = " ";

 public static void main(String[] args) throws PDFException {
 // Initialize library
 int error_code = Library.initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != e_ErrSuccess) {
 return;
 }
 {
 PDFDoc pdfDoc = new PDFDoc("inputPath");
 pdfDoc.load(null);

 HeaderFooter headerfooter = pdfDoc.getEditableHeaderFooter();
 // Update header-footer
 HeaderFooterContentGenerator contentgenerator = new HeaderFooterContentGenerator();
 contentgenerator.addDate(e_DateFormatMSlashDSlashYYYY);
 contentgenerator.addString(" foxit");
 HeaderFooterContent content = headerfooter.getContent();
 content.setHeader_right_content(contentgenerator.generateContent());
 headerfooter.setContent(content);
 pdfDoc.updateHeaderFooter(headerfooter);
 String output_file = "HeaderFooter_UpdateHeaderFooter.pdf";
 pdfDoc.saveAs(output_file, e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}

How to add a line annotation

```java
import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.DateTime;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.fxcrt.PointF;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.fxcrt.RectF;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.annots.Annot;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.annots.Line;

class TestCase {

 public void testUint() {
 Library.initialize("sn", "key");
 try {
 //load document
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("sample.pdf");
 int error_code = doc.load(null);
 if (error_code != Constants.e_ErrSuccess) return;

 PDFPage page = doc.getPage(0);
 // Add line annotation
 // No special intent, as a common line.
 Line line = new Line(page.addAnnot(Annot.e_Line, new RectF(0, 650, 100, 750)));
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 line.setFlags(4);
 line.setStartPoint(new PointF(20, 650));
 line.setEndPoint(new PointF(100, 740));
 // Intent, as line arrow.
 line.setContent("A line arrow annotation");
 line.setIntent("LineArrow");
 line.setSubject("Arrow");
 line.setTitle("Foxit SDK");
 line.setCreationDateTime(DateTime.getLocalTime());
 line.setModifiedDateTime(DateTime.getLocalTime());
 // Appearance must be reset.
 line.resetAppearanceStream();

 // Save PDF file
 String newPdf = "newpdf.pdf";
 doc.saveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}
```

how to add and sign a new Signature

import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.fxcrt.RectF;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage;

import static com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants.e_ErrSuccess;
import static com.foxit.sdk.pdf.Signature.e_DigestSHA1;

public class Signature {
 static String key = " ";
 static String sn = " ";

 public static void main(String[] args) throws PDFException {
 int error_code = Library.initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != e_ErrSuccess) {
 return ;
 }
 {
 PDFDoc pdf_doc = new PDFDoc(input_file);
 pdf_doc.startLoad(null, false, null);
 PDFPage pdf_page = pdf_doc.getPage(0);
 // Add a new Signature to first page.

 RectF rectF = new RectF(100,100,200,200);
 com.foxit.sdk.pdf.Signature new_signature = pdf_page.addSignature(rectF);
 // Set filter and subfilter for the new Signature.
 new_signature.setFilter("Adobe.PPKLite");
 new_signature.setSubFilter("adbe.pkcs7.detached");
 // Sign the new Signature.
 new_signature.startSign("foxit_all.pfx", "123456".getBytes(),
 e_DigestSHA1, "signed_newsignature.pdf", null, null);
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}

---

how to do some operation about PDF object

import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.DateTime;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.objects.PDFArray;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.objects.PDFObject;

import java.io.File;

import static com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants.e_ErrSuccess;
import static com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal;

public class TestPDFObject2 {
 private final static String key = " ";
 private final static String sn = " ";

 static String input_file = " ";
 static String output_path = " ";

 // This function is to do some operation to PDF object.
 static void ObjectOperation(PDFDoc document) throws PDFException {
 PDFObject boolean_object = PDFObject.createFromBoolean(true);
 int boolean_object_number = document.addIndirectObject(boolean_object);

 boolean boolean_object_value = boolean_object.getBoolean();

 PDFObject float_object = PDFObject.createFromFloat(0.1f);
 int float_object_number = document.addIndirectObject(float_object);

 float float_object_value = float_object.getFloat();

 PDFObject integer_object = PDFObject.createFromInteger(1);
 int integer_object_number = document.addIndirectObject(integer_object);

 int integer_object_value = integer_object.getInteger();

 PDFObject string_object = PDFObject.createFromString("foxit");
 int string_object_number = document.addIndirectObject(string_object);

 String string_object_value = string_object.getWideString();

 PDFObject name_object = PDFObject.createFromName("sdk");
 int name_object_number = document.addIndirectObject(name_object);

 String name_object_value = name_object.getName();

 DateTime date_time = new DateTime(2017, 9, 27, 19, 36, 6, 0, (short) 8, 0);
 PDFObject datetime_object = PDFObject.createFromDateTime(date_time);
 int datetime_object_number = document.addIndirectObject(datetime_object);

 String datetime_object_value = datetime_object.getWideString();

 PDFArray array = PDFArray.create();
 PDFObject boolean_object_reference = PDFObject.createReference(document, boolean_object_number);
 int boolean_object_reference_number = boolean_object_reference.getObjNum();

 PDFObject float_object_reference = PDFObject.createReference(document, float_object_number);
 PDFObject integer_object_reference = PDFObject.createReference(document, integer_object_number);
 PDFObject integer_object_direct = integer_object_reference.getDirectObject();

 PDFObject string_object_reference = PDFObject.createReference(document, string_object_number);
 PDFObject name_object_reference = PDFObject.createReference(document, name_object_number);
 PDFObject datetime_object_reference = PDFObject.createReference(document, datetime_object_number);

 array.addElement(boolean_object_reference);
 array.addElement(float_object_reference);
 array.addElement(integer_object_reference);
 array.addElement(string_object_reference);
 array.addElement(name_object_reference);
 array.addElement(datetime_object_reference);
 array.addElement(boolean_object.cloneObject());

 int array_object_number = document.addIndirectObject(array);

 }

 public static void main(String[] args) throws PDFException {
 File myPath = new File(output_path);
 // Initialize library
 int error_code = Library.initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != e_ErrSuccess) {
 return;
 }
 {
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(input_file);
 doc.startLoad(null, false, null);

 // Do some operation about PDF object.
 ObjectOperation(doc);
 String save_pdf_patth = "pdfobjects_addnewobjects.pdf";
 doc.startSaveAs(save_pdf_patth, e_SaveFlagNoOriginal, null);
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}

---

how to import page

import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Progressive;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Range;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;

import java.io.File;

import static com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants.e_ErrSuccess;
import static com.foxit.sdk.common.Progressive.e_Finished;
import static com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc.e_ImportFlagNormal;
import static com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNormal;

public class page_organization {
 static String key = " ";
 static String sn = " ";

 static String file_src = "";
 static String output_path = "";

 static void ImportPage() throws PDFException {
 PDFDoc doc_dest = new PDFDoc("page_organization_123.pdf");
 int code = doc_dest.load(null);
 PDFDoc doc_src = new PDFDoc("page_organization_abc.pdf");
 code = doc_src.load(null);
 Range import_ranges = new Range(0);
 import_ranges.addSingle(doc_src.getPageCount() - 1);

 // Import page from PDFDoc object.
 Progressive progressive =
 doc_dest.startImportPages(-1, doc_src, e_ImportFlagNormal, "abc", import_ranges, null);
 while (progressive.resume() != e_Finished) {
 }
 String output_file = "page_organization_abc_to_123_import_pages.pdf";
 doc_dest.saveAs(output_file, e_SaveFlagNormal);

 doc_dest = new PDFDoc("page_organization_123.pdf");
 code = doc_dest.load(null);

 // Import page from file path.
 progressive = doc_dest.startImportPagesFromFilePath(-1, file_src, null, e_ImportFlagNormal, "abc",
 import_ranges, null);

 while (progressive.resume() != e_Finished) {
 }
 output_file = "abc_to_123_import_pages_form_filepath.pdf";
 doc_dest.saveAs(output_file, e_SaveFlagNormal);
 }

 public static void main(String[] args) throws PDFException {
 File myPath = new File(output_path);
 // Initialize library
 int error_code = Library.initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != e_ErrSuccess) {
 return;
 }
 {
 ImportPage();
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}

---

How to display a specified page with Foxit PDF SDK for Android?

To display a specified page when opening a PDF file, the interface __gotoPage (int pageIndex)__ should
be used. Foxit PDF SDK for Android utilizes multi-thread to improve rendering speed, so please make
sure the document has been loaded successfully before using the __gotoPage__ interface.
Please implement the callback interface in the __IDocEventListener__, and then call the __gotoPage__
interface in the __onDocOpened__ event. Following is the sample code:

```java
 // Assuming A PDFViewCtrl has been created.
 // Register the PDF document event listener.
 pdfViewCtrl.registerDocEventListener(docListener);
 // Open an unencrypted PDF document from a specified PDF file path.
 String path = "/mnt/sdcard/input_files/Sample.pdf";
 pdfViewCtrl.openDoc(path, null);

 PDFViewCtrl.IDocEventListener docListener = new PDFViewCtrl.IDocEventListener() {
 @Override
 public void onDocWillOpen() {}

 @Override
 public void onDocLoading(PDFDoc pdfDoc, int i) {
 }

 @Override
 public void onDocOpened(PDFDoc pdfDoc, int errCode) {
 pdfViewCtrl.gotoPage(2);
 }
 @Override
 public void onDocWillClose(PDFDoc pdfDoc) { }
 @Override
 public void onDocClosed(PDFDoc pdfDoc, int i) { }
 @Override
 public void onDocWillSave(PDFDoc pdfDoc) { }
 @Override
 public void onDocSaved(PDFDoc pdfDoc, int i) { }
 };
```

how to import page use optimized way

import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Progressive;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Range;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;

import java.io.File;

import static com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants.e_ErrSuccess;
import static com.foxit.sdk.common.Progressive.e_Finished;
import static com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc.e_ExtractPagesOptionAnnotation;
import static com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc.e_InsertDocOptionAttachments;
import static com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNormal;

public class page_organization {
 static String key = " ";
 static String sn = " ";

 static String input_path = "";
 static String output_path = "";

 static void ImportPageOptimized() throws PDFException {
 String file_src = input_path + "page_organization_abc.pdf";
 PDFDoc doc_dest = new PDFDoc("page_organization_123.pdf");
 int code = doc_dest.load(null);
 if (code != e_ErrSuccess) {
 return;
 }
 PDFDoc doc_src = new PDFDoc("page_organization_abc.pdf");
 code = doc_src.load(null);
 if (code != e_ErrSuccess) {
 return;
 }
 // Extract pages to temporary document
 Range import_ranges = new Range(0);
 import_ranges.addSingle(doc_src.getPageCount() - 1);
 String file_temp = "page_organization_import_extracted_pages.pdf";
 Progressive progressive =
 doc_src.startExtractPages(file_temp, e_ExtractPagesOptionAnnotation, import_ranges, null);
 while (progressive.resume() != e_Finished) {
 }

 PDFDoc doc_temp = new PDFDoc(file_temp);
 code = doc_temp.load(null);
 if (code != e_ErrSuccess) {
 return;
 }

 // Insert temporary document into destination
 doc_dest.insertDocument(-1, doc_temp, e_InsertDocOptionAttachments);
 String output_file = "abc_to_123_insert_document.pdf";
 doc_dest.saveAs(output_file, e_SaveFlagNormal);
 }

 public static void main(String[] args) throws PDFException {
 File myPath = new File(output_path);
 // Initialize library
 int error_code = Library.initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != e_ErrSuccess) {
 return;
 }
 {
 ImportPageOptimized();
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}

How to search for full text with Foxit PDF SDK for Android

To use this feature, follows the steps below:

1. Get document source information. Create a document source based on a directory which will be used as the search directory.
```java
com.foxit.sdk.fts.DocumentsSource#DocumentsSource(String directory)
```

2. Create a full text search object, and set a path of database to store the indexed data.
```java
com.foxit.sdk.fts.FullTextSearch() # public void setDataBasePath(String pathOfDataBase)

```
3. Start to index the PDF documents which receive from the source
```java
import com.foxit.sdk.fts.FullTextSearch;

FullTextSearch() # public Progressive startUpdateIndex(DocumentsSource source, PauseCallback pause, boolean reUpdate)
```
__Note:__ You can index a specified PDF file. For example, if the contents of a PDF file have been changed, you can re-index it using the following API:
```java
com.foxit.sdk.fts.FullTextSearch() # public boolean updateIndexWithFilePath(String file_path)
```

4. Search the specified keyword from the indexed data source. The search results will be returned to external by a specified callback function when a matched one is found.
```java
com.foxit.sdk.fts.FullTextSearch() # public boolean searchOf(String match_string, int rank_mode, SearchCallback callback)
```

Following is a sample for how to use it:
```java

public class TestCase {

 public void testUint() {
 Library.initialize("sn", "key");
 try {
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("Sample.pdf");
 int error_code = doc.load(null);
 if (error_code != Constants.e_ErrSuccess) return;

 String directory = "A search directory...";
 FullTextSearch search = new FullTextSearch();
 String dbPath = "The path of data base to store the indexed data...";
 search.setDataBasePath(dbPath);
 // Get document source information.
 DocumentsSource source = new DocumentsSource(directory);
 // Create a Pause callback object implemented by users to pause the updating process.
 PauseUtil pause = new PauseUtil(30);
 // Start to update the index of PDF files which receive from the source.
 Progressive progressive = search.startUpdateIndex(source, pause, false);
 int state = Progressive.e_ToBeContinued;
 while (state == Progressive.e_ToBeContinued) {
 state = progressive.resume();
 }
 // Create a callback object which will be invoked when a matched one is found.
 SearchCallbackImpl searchCallback = new SearchCallbackImpl();
 // Search the specified keyword from the indexed data source.
 search.searchOf("looking for this text", FullTextSearch.e_RankHitCountASC, searchCallback);
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 Library.release();
 }

}
```

__PauseUtil__
```java
import com.foxit.sdk.common.fxcrt.PauseCallback;
import java.util.Date;

class PauseUtil extends PauseCallback {
 private long m_milliseconds = 0;
 private long m_startTime = 0;

 public PauseUtil(long milliSeconds) {
 Date date = new Date();
 m_milliseconds = milliSeconds;
 m_startTime = date.getTime();
 }

 @Override
 public boolean needToPauseNow() {
 if (this.m_milliseconds < 1) return false;
 Date date = new Date();
 long diff = date.getTime() - m_startTime;
 if (diff > this.m_milliseconds) {
 m_startTime = date.getTime();
 return true;
 } else return false;
 }
}
```

__SearchCallbackImpl_
```java
import com.foxit.sdk.fts.SearchCallback;
import java.util.Locale;

public class SearchCallbackImpl extends SearchCallback {
 @Override
 public void release() {
 }

 @Override
 public int retrieveSearchResult(String filePath, int pageIndex, String matchResult, int matchStartTextIndex, int matchEndTextIndex) {
 return 0;
 }
}
```
__Note:__
* The indexed full text search provided by Foxit PDF SDK for Android will go through a directory
 recursively, so that both the files and the folders under the search directory will be indexed.
* If you want to abort the index process, you can pass in a pause callback parameter to the
__startUpdateIndex__ interface. The callback function __needToPauseNow__ will be invoked once a
 PDF document is indexed, so that the caller can abort the index process when the callback
 __needToPauseNow__ return "true"

How to add a new attachment?

```java
import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.Attachments;

 public void testUint() {

 Library.initialize("sn", "key");
 try {
 //load document
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("sample.pdf");
 int error_code = doc.load(null);
 if (error_code != Constants.e_ErrSuccess) return;

 Attachments attachment = new Attachments(doc,new PDFNameTree());
 // Add a new attachment to PDF document.
 attachment.addFromFilePath("OriginalAttachmentsInfo", "AboutFoxit.pdf");

 // Save PDF file
 String newPdf = "newpdf.pdf";
 doc.saveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}
```

How to print a pdf document with Foxit PDF SDK for Android

Foxit PDF SDK for Android supported the print feature from version 5.1. You can press the
Wireless Print button on the More Menu view in the Complete PDF viewer demo to print the PDF
document. Furthermore, you can call the following API to print the PDF documents:

```java
import com.foxit.uiextensions.UIExtensionsManager;

import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.uiextensions.modules.print.IPrintResultCallback;

public class TestCase {

 public void testUint() {
 try {
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("Sample.pdf");
 int error_code = doc.load(null);
 if (error_code != Constants.e_ErrSuccess) return;

 uiExtensionsManager.startPrintJob(mContext, doc, "printJobName", "fileName", printResultCallback);
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 }

 IPrintResultCallback printResultCallback = new IPrintResultCallback() {
 @Override
 public void printFinished() {
 }

 @Override
 public void printFailed() {
 }

 @Override
 public void printCancelled() {
 }
 };

}
```

how to move page

import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Range;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage;

import java.io.File;

import static com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants.e_ErrSuccess;
import static com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNormal;

public class MovePage{
 static String key = " ";
 static String sn = " ";
 static String output_path = "";

 static void MovePages() throws PDFException {
 // Move page
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc( "page_organization_123.pdf");
 int code = doc.load(null);
 if (code != e_ErrSuccess) {
 return;
 }
 int count = doc.getPageCount();
 PDFPage page = doc.getPage(0);
 doc.movePageTo(page, doc.getPageCount() - 1);
 String output_file1 = "move_first_page_to_last.pdf";
 doc.saveAs(output_file1, e_SaveFlagNormal);

 doc = new PDFDoc("page_organization_abc.pdf");
 code = doc.load(null);
 if (code != e_ErrSuccess) {
 return;
 }
 Range page_set = new Range();
 for (int i = 0; i < count / 2; i++) {
 page_set.addSingle(2 * i);
 }
 doc.movePagesTo(page_set, doc.getPageCount() - 1);
 String output_file = "move_pages.pdf";
 doc.saveAs(output_file, e_SaveFlagNormal);
 System.out.println("Move pages.");
 }

 public static void main(String[] args) throws PDFException {
 File myPath = new File(output_path);
 // Initialize library
 int error_code = Library.initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != e_ErrSuccess) {
 return;
 }
 {
 MovePages();
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}

```java
import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;

 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("AboutFoxit.pdf");

 if (error_code != Constants.e_ErrSuccess) return;

 //Get bookmark root node or Create new bookmark root node.
 Bookmark root = doc.getRootBookmark();
 // Get first bookmark and change properties.
 Bookmark first_bookmark = root.getFirstChild();
 first_bookmark.setStyle(Bookmark.e_StyleItalic);
 first_bookmark.setColor(0xFF0000);
 first_bookmark.setTitle("Change bookmark title, style, and color");
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();

}
```

how to create layer tree

import android.text.TextUtils;
import android.util.Log;

import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.*;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.fxcrt.Matrix2D;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.*;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.graphics.GraphicsObject;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.FileWriter;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.Locale;

import static com.foxit.sdk.common.Bitmap.e_DIBArgb;
import static com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants.e_ErrSuccess;
import static com.foxit.sdk.pdf.LayerContext.e_UsageView;
import static com.foxit.sdk.pdf.LayerTree.*;
import static com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNormal;
import static com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage.e_ParsePageNormal;

public class Pdflayer {
 static final String key = " ";
 static final String sn = " ";

 static void setAllLayerNodesVisible(LayerContext context, LayerNode layer_node, boolean visible) throws PDFException {
 if (layer_node.hasLayer()) {
 context.setVisible(layer_node, false);
 }
 int count = layer_node.getChildrenCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
 LayerNode child = layer_node.getChild(i);
 setAllLayerNodesVisible(context, child, visible);
 }
 }

 static void renderAllLayerNodes(PDFDoc doc, LayerContext context, LayerNode layer_node, String pdf_name) throws PDFException {
 if (layer_node.hasLayer()) {
 context.setVisible(layer_node, true);
 int nCount = doc.getPageCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < nCount; i++) {
 PDFPage page = doc.getPage(i);
 String s = String.format("%d", i);
 String layer_name = layer_node.getName();
 layer_name = layer_name.replace(":", "");
 layer_name = layer_name.replace(">", "");
 layer_name = layer_name.replace("<", "");
 layer_name = layer_name.replace("=", "");
 String file_name = output_path + "page_" + s + "_layer_node_" + layer_name + ".bmp";

 renderPageToImage(page, file_name);
 }
 }

 int count = layer_node.getChildrenCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
 LayerNode child = layer_node.getChild(i);
 renderAllLayerNodes(doc, context, child, pdf_name);
 }
 if (layer_node.hasLayer()) {
 // The visibility of parent layer will affect the children layers,
 // so reset the visibility of parent layer after children have been rendered.
 context.setVisible(layer_node, false);
 }
 }

 public static void main(String[] args) throws PDFException {
 // Initialize library
 int error_code = Library.initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != e_ErrSuccess) {
 return;
 }
 {
 // Create layer tree
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("OCTest_src.pdf");
 error_code = doc.load(null);
 boolean has_layer = doc.hasLayer();
 LayerTree layertree = new LayerTree(doc);
 has_layer = doc.hasLayer();
 LayerNode root = layertree.getRootNode();
 int children_count = root.getChildrenCount();
 root.addChild(0, "AddedLayerNode", true);
 root.addChild(0, "AddedNode", false);
 String file_info = "create_layer_informations.txt";
 FileWriter create_info = null;
 try {
 create_info = new FileWriter(file_info, false);
 getAllLayerNodesInformation(root, -1, create_info);
 } catch (IOException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 } finally {
 if (create_info != null) {
 try {
 create_info.close();
 } catch (IOException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 }
 }
 String output_file = "create_layer_tree.pdf";
 doc.saveAs(output_file, e_SaveFlagNormal);
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}

how to output preview

import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.Color;

import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Image;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Renderer;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.fxcrt.Matrix2D;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.OutputPreview;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage;

import java.util.ArrayList;

import static com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants.e_ErrSuccess;
import static com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants.e_Rotation0;
import static com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage.e_ParsePageNormal;

public class output_preview {
 static String key = " ";
 static String sn = " ";

 static String output_path = "";

 public static void main(String[] args) throws PDFException {
 // Initialize library
 int error_code = Library.initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != e_ErrSuccess) {
 return;
 }
 {
 PDFDoc pdf_doc = new PDFDoc("page_organization_123.pdf");
 pdf_doc.load(null);
 PDFPage pdf_page = pdf_doc.getPage(0);
 pdf_page.startParse(e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);
 float page_width = pdf_page.getWidth();
 float page_height = pdf_page.getHeight();
 int bitmap_width = (int) page_width;
 int bitmap_height = (int) page_height;
 android.graphics.Bitmap.Config bitmap_format;
 int background_color;
 if (pdf_page.hasTransparency()) {
 background_color =Color.BLACK;
 bitmap_format = Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888;
 } else {
 background_color = Color.WHITE;
 bitmap_format = Bitmap.Config.RGB_565;
 }
 Matrix2D display_matrix = pdf_page.getDisplayMatrix(0, 0, bitmap_width, bitmap_height, e_Rotation0);

 Bitmap render_bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(bitmap_width, bitmap_height, bitmap_format);
 render_bitmap.eraseColor(background_color);

 Renderer renderer = new Renderer(render_bitmap, false);

 OutputPreview output_preview = new OutputPreview(pdf_doc);
 output_preview.setSimulationProfile("icc_profile/USWebCoatedSWOP.icc");
 output_preview.setShowType(OutputPreview.e_ShowAll);
 ArrayList<String> process_plates = output_preview.getPlates(OutputPreview.e_ColorantTypeProcess);
 ArrayList<String> spot_plates = output_preview.getPlates(OutputPreview.e_ColorantTypeSpot);

 // Set check status of spot plate to be true, if there's any spot plate.
 for (int i = 0; i < spot_plates.size(); i++) {
 output_preview.setCheckStatus(spot_plates.get(i), true);
 }

 // Only set one process plate to be checked each time and generate the preview bitmap.
 for (int i = 0; i < process_plates.size(); i++) {
 if (0 != i)
 output_preview.setCheckStatus(process_plates.get(i - 1), false);
 output_preview.setCheckStatus(process_plates.get(i), true);

 Bitmap preview_bitmap = output_preview.generatePreviewBitmap(pdf_page, display_matrix, renderer);

 Image result_image = new Image();
 result_image.addFrame(preview_bitmap);
 String saved_file_path = "preview_result_ProcessPlate[" + i + "]_true.bmp";
 result_image.saveAs(saved_file_path);
 }
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}

How to add a squiggly annotation

```java
import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.DateTime;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.fxcrt.PointF;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.fxcrt.RectF;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.annots.Annot;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.annots.QuadPoints;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.annots.QuadPointsArray;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.annots.Squiggly;

class TestCase {

 public void testUint() {
 Library.initialize("sn", "key");
 try {
 //load document
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("sample.pdf");
 int error_code = doc.load(null);
 if (error_code != Constants.e_ErrSuccess) return;

 PDFPage page = doc.getPage(0);

 // Add link annotation
 Annot annot = page.addAnnot(Annot.e_Squiggly, new RectF(200, 450, 300, 550));

 Squiggly squiggly = new Squiggly(annot);
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 squiggly.setFlags(Annot.e_FlagPrint);
 squiggly.setIntent("Squiggly");

 QuadPoints quad_points = new QuadPoints();
 quad_points.setFirst(new PointF(210, 500));
 quad_points.setSecond(new PointF(290, 500));
 quad_points.setThird(new PointF(210, 480));
 quad_points.setFourth(new PointF(290, 480));
 QuadPointsArray quad_points_array = new QuadPointsArray();
 quad_points_array.add(quad_points);
 squiggly.setQuadPoints(quad_points_array);
 squiggly.setSubject("Squiggly");
 squiggly.setTitle("Foxit SDK");
 squiggly.setCreationDateTime(DateTime.getLocalTime());
 squiggly.setModifiedDateTime(DateTime.getLocalTime());
 // Appearance should be reset.
 squiggly.resetAppearanceStream();

 // Save PDF file
 String newPdf = "newpdf.pdf";
 doc.saveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}
```

如何屏蔽注释右键菜单中菜单项（android， java, UIExtensionsManager）

__通过接口屏蔽canModify、canDelete、canReply菜单__

想要将右键菜单中回复、删除项屏蔽，
可以通过 `UIExtensionsManager#setAnnotationPermission` 接口来实现，对应菜单项 `return false`
```java
 mUiExtensionsManager.setAnnotationsPermission(new IAnnotationsPermission() {
 @Override
 public boolean canAdd() {
 return true;
 }

 @Override
 public boolean canModify() {
 return false;
 }

 @Override
 public boolean canDelete() {
 return false;
 }
 });
```

how to insert page in pdf

import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.fxcrt.RectF;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.annots.Annot;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.annots.FreeText;

import java.io.File;

import static com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants.e_ErrSuccess;
import static com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNormal;

public class page_organization {
 static String key = " ";
 static String sn = " ";

 static String output_path = "";

 static void InsertPage() throws PDFException {
 String input_file = "page_organization_123.pdf";
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(input_file);
 int code = doc.load(null);

 PDFPage page = doc.insertPage(-1, PDFPage.e_SizeLetter);
 addTextAnnot(page, "insert in first");
 page = doc.insertPage(2, PDFPage.e_SizeLetter);
 addTextAnnot(page, "insert in 2 (based 0)");
 page = doc.insertPage(doc.getPageCount(), PDFPage.e_SizeLetter);
 addTextAnnot(page, "insert in last");
 String output_file = "insert_page.pdf";
 doc.saveAs(output_file, e_SaveFlagNormal);
 System.out.println("Insert pages.");
 }

 static void addTextAnnot(PDFPage page, String content) {
 try {
 Annot annot = page.addAnnot(Annot.e_FreeText, new RectF(100, 200, 200, 250));
 FreeText freeText = new FreeText(annot);
 freeText.setContent(content);
 freeText.resetAppearanceStream();
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 }

 public static void main(String[] args) throws PDFException {
 File myPath = new File(output_path);
 // Initialize library
 int error_code = Library.initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != e_ErrSuccess) {
 return;
 }
 {
 InsertPage();
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}

---

Key Features of Foxit PDF SDK for Android

Foxit PDF SDK for Android has several main features which help app developers quickly implement
the functions that they really need and reduce the development cost.

| Features | Description |
|---------------:|----------------------------------------------------------------------|
| PDF Document | Open and close files, set and get metadata. |
| PDF Page | Parse, render, read, and edit PDF pages. |
| Render | Graphics engine created on a bitmap for platform graphics device. |
| Reflow | Rearrange page content. |
| Crop | Crop PDF pages for betting reading |
| Text Select | Select text in a PDF document. |
| Text Search | Search text in a PDF document, and provide indexed Full-Text Search. |
| Outline | Directly locate and link to point of interest within a document. |
|ReadingBookmark | Mark progress and interesting passages as users read. |
|Annotation | Create, edit and remove annotations. |
|Layers | Add, edit, and remove optional content groups. |
|Attachments | Add, edit, and remove document level attachments. |
|Form | Fill form with JavaScript support, export and import form data by XFDF/FDF/XML file.Support to create TextField, CheckBox, RadioButton, ComboBox, ListBox,and Signature Field.|
|XFA | Support static and dynamic XFA. |
|Signature | Sign a PDF document, verify a signature, add or delete a signature field.Add and verify third-party digital signature.Support Long term validation of signatures (LTV).|
|Fill | Fill flat forms (i.e. non-interactive forms) with text and symbols. |
|Security | Protect PDFs with password or certificate. |
|Pan and Zoom | Adjust the magnification and position of the view area to match the area in an adjustable rectangle in the Pan & Zoom window's thumbnail view of the page. |
|Print | Print PDF document. |
|RMS | Support Microsoft RMS decryption with the standard IRMv1 and IRMv2. |
|Comparison | Compare two PDF documents, and mark the differences between them. |
|Scanning | Scan and convert paper documents to PDFs |
|Speak | Support to read out the text of PDF file. |
|Split Screen | Support split screen. |
|Right to Left| Support Right to Left. |
|Out of Memory | Recover from an OOM condition. |

__Note__: Outline is the technical term used in the PDF specification for what is commonly known as
bookmarks in traditional desktop PDF viewers. Reading bookmarks are commonly used on mobile and
tablet PDF viewers to mark progress and interesting passages as users read but are not technically outline
and are stored at app level rather than within the PDF itself.

---

如何修改默认文件夹

通过修改UIExtensions的源码 `\libs\uiextensions_src\src\main\java\com\foxit\uiextensions\utils\AppFileUtil` 来修改默认文件夹

Foxit PDF SDK for Android 目前不支持自定义文件夹的选择，即没有接口支持。
但RDK包中有提供UIExtensions Component的源码，可以通过直接调整源码来达到目的。

使用源码的方式：请参看\docs目录下的developer guide，"4.3 Customize UI implementation through source code"。

源码位置：`\libs\uiextensions_src`

修改文件： `\libs\uiextensions_src\src\main\java\com\foxit\uiextensions\utils\AppFileUtil`

代码位置：
`\libs\uiextensions_src\src\main\java\com\foxit\uiextensions\utils\AppFileUtil#getDefaultDocumentDirectory`

```java
 public static String getDefaultDocumentDirectory() {
 return needScopedStorageAdaptation() ? AppFileUtil.getSDPath() : (getSDPath() + File.separator + "FoxitSDK");
 }
```

如果需要更改目录，只需要将 `getDefaultDocumentDirectory()` 的默认返回做个修改就好，然后重新编译成aar

how to fill sign

```java
import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Font;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.fxcrt.PointF;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.FillSign;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.FillSignObject;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.SignatureFillSignObject;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.TextFillSignObjectData;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.TextFillSignObjectDataArray;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.graphics.TextState;

public class TestCase {

 public void testUint() {
 Library.initialize("sn", "key");
 try {
 //load document
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("sample.pdf");
 int error_code = doc.load(null);
 if (error_code != Constants.e_ErrSuccess) return;

 PDFPage page = doc.getPage(0);
 page.startParse(PDFPage.e_ParsePageNormal, null ,false);

 FillSign fillsign = new FillSign(page);
 FillSignObject fillsignobject = fillsign.addObject(FillSign.e_FillSignObjectTypeCrossMark, new PointF(0, 0), 100, 100, Constants.e_Rotation0);
 fillsignobject = fillsign.addObject(FillSign.e_FillSignObjectTypeCheckMark, new PointF(100, 100), 50, 100, Constants.e_Rotation0);
 fillsignobject = fillsign.addObject(FillSign.e_FillSignObjectTypeRoundRectangle, new PointF(200, 200), 100, 50, Constants.e_Rotation0);
 fillsignobject = fillsign.addObject(FillSign.e_FillSignObjectTypeLine, new PointF(300, 300), 100, 50, Constants.e_Rotation0);
 fillsignobject = fillsign.addObject(FillSign.e_FillSignObjectTypeDot, new PointF(400, 400), 100, 100, Constants.e_Rotation0);

 //TextFillSignObject
 TextFillSignObjectDataArray textdataarray = new TextFillSignObjectDataArray();
 TextFillSignObjectData textdata = new TextFillSignObjectData();
 TextState textState = new TextState();
 Font font = new Font(Font.e_StdIDHelvetica);

 textState.setFont(font);
 textState.setFont_size(20);
 textState.setOrigin_position(new PointF(500,0));
 textState.setCharspace(1.0f);
 textdata.setText("666777888");
 textdata.setText_state(textState);
 textdataarray.add(textdata);
 FillSignObject text = fillsign.addTextObject(textdataarray, new PointF(400, 100), 200, 200, Constants.e_Rotation0, false);
 text.generateContent();

 //SignatureFillSignObject
 fillsignobject = fillsign.addObject(FillSign.e_FillSignObjectTypeSignature, new PointF(300, 100), 100, 100, Constants.e_Rotation0);
 Bitmap bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap(100, 100, Bitmap.Config.RGB_565);
 bitmap.eraseColor(0xFFFF0000);

 SignatureFillSignObject signatureFillSignObject = new SignatureFillSignObject(fillsignobject);
 signatureFillSignObject.setBitmap(bitmap);
 fillsignobject.generateContent();
 page.generateContent();

 // Save PDF file
 String newPdf = "newpdf.pdf";
 doc.saveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNormal);
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 Library.release();
 }

}
```

how to add check box

```java
import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.fxcrt.RectF;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.annots.Widget;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.interform.Control;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.interform.Field;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.interform.Form;

public class TestCase {
 private static final String TAG = TestCase.class.getSimpleName();

 public void testUint() {
 Library.initialize("sn", "key");
 try {
 //load document
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("sample.pdf");
 int error_code = doc.load(null);
 if (error_code != Constants.e_ErrSuccess) return;

 Form form = new Form(doc);
 PDFPage page = doc.insertPage(0, PDFPage.e_SizeLetter);

 // Add check box
 Control control = form.addControl(page, "Check Box0", Field.e_TypeCheckBox, new RectF(50, 650, 90, 690));
 control.setChecked(true);

 Widget widget = control.getWidget();
 widget.setMKBorderColor(0x000000);
 widget.setMKBackgroundColor(0xFFFFFF);
 widget.resetAppearanceStream();

 // Save PDF file
 String newPdf = "newpdf.pdf";
 doc.saveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNormal);
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 Library.release();
 }

}
```

how to compare two pdf documents and marked the difference of delete type

import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.addon.comparison.CompareResultInfo;
import com.foxit.sdk.addon.comparison.CompareResultInfoArray;
import com.foxit.sdk.addon.comparison.CompareResults;
import com.foxit.sdk.addon.comparison.Comparison;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.DateTime;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.fxcrt.PointF;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.fxcrt.RectF;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.fxcrt.RectFArray;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.annots.Annot;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.annots.QuadPoints;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.annots.QuadPointsArray;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.annots.StrikeOut;

import java.util.UUID;

public class TestCase {

 public void testUint() throws PDFException {
 // Initialize library
 int error_code = Library.initialize("sn", "key");
 if (error_code != Constants.e_ErrSuccess) {
 return;
 }
 {
 PDFDoc base_doc = new PDFDoc( "test_base.pdf");
 PDFDoc compared_doc = new PDFDoc("test_compared.pdf");
 Comparison comparison = new Comparison(base_doc, compared_doc);
 CompareResults result = comparison.doCompare(0, 0, Comparison.e_CompareTypeText);
 CompareResultInfoArray oldInfo = result.getBase_doc_results();
 CompareResultInfoArray newInfo = result.getCompared_doc_results();
 long oldInfoSize = oldInfo.getSize();
 long newInfoSize = newInfo.getSize();
 PDFPage page = compared_doc.getPage(0);
 PDFPage page1 = base_doc.getPage(0);
 for (int i=0; i<oldInfoSize; i++)
 {
 CompareResultInfo item = oldInfo.getAt(i);
 int type = item.getType();
 if (type == CompareResultInfo.e_CompareResultTypeDeleteText)
 {
 String res_string;
 res_string = String.format("[Old]: \"%s\"\r\n[New]: \"%s\"", newInfo.getAt(i).getDiff_contents(), item.getDiff_contents());
 CreateDeleteText(page1, item.getRect_array(), 0xe7651a, res_string, "Compare : Replace", "Text");
 }
 }
 // Save the comparison result to a PDF file.
 compared_doc.saveAs( "result.pdf", PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNormal);
 }
 Library.release();
 }

 void CreateDeleteText(PDFPage page, RectFArray rects, int color, String csContents, String csType, String csObjType) throws PDFException
 {
 int rectSize = rects.getSize();
 if (rectSize == 0) return;
 StrikeOut strikeout = new StrikeOut(page.addAnnot(Annot.e_StrikeOut, new RectF()));
 strikeout.setContent(csContents);

 QuadPointsArray quad_points_array = new QuadPointsArray();

 for (int i=0; i<rectSize; i++)
 {
 RectF item = rects.getAt(i);
 QuadPoints quad_points = new QuadPoints();
 quad_points.setFirst(new PointF(item.getLeft(), item.getTop()));
 quad_points.setSecond(new PointF(item.getRight(), item.getTop()));
 quad_points.setThird(new PointF(item.getLeft(), item.getBottom()));
 quad_points.setFourth(new PointF(item.getRight(), item.getBottom()));
 quad_points_array.add(quad_points);
 }
 strikeout.setQuadPoints(quad_points_array);

 strikeout.setBorderColor(color);
 strikeout.setSubject(csObjType);
 strikeout.setTitle(csType);
 strikeout.setCreationDateTime(new DateTime());
 strikeout.setModifiedDateTime(new DateTime());
 strikeout.setUniqueID(UUID.randomUUID().toString());

 strikeout.resetAppearanceStream();
 }
}

How to load a PDF document from memory?

```java
import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileInputStream;
import java.io.IOException;

public class TestCase {
 private static final String TAG = TestCase.class.getSimpleName();

 public void testUint() {
 Library.initialize("sn", "key");
 try {
 File file = new File("sample.pdf");
 FileInputStream inputStream = new FileInputStream(file);
 byte[] buffer = new byte[(int) file.length()];
 inputStream.read(buffer);
 inputStream.close();

 //load document
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(buffer);
 int error_code = doc.load(null);
 if (error_code != Constants.e_ErrSuccess) return;
 } catch (PDFException | IOException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 Library.release();
 }

}
```

how to flatten a pdf without annotations and form controls

```java
import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage;

public class TestCase {

 public void testUint() {
 Library.initialize("sn", "key");
 try {
 //load document
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("sample.pdf");
 int error_code = doc.load(null);
 if (error_code != Constants.e_ErrSuccess) return;

 int pageCount = doc.getPageCount();
 // Flatten PDF pages.
 for (int i = 0; i < pageCount; i++) {
 PDFPage page = doc.getPage(i);
 // Parse page before flattening the page.
 page.startParse(PDFPage.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);
 // Flatten a PDF page without annotations
 page.flatten(true, PDFPage.e_FlattenNoAnnot | PDFPage.e_FlattenNoFormControl);
 }
 // Save PDF file
 String newPdf = "newpdf.pdf";
 doc.saveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNormal);
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 } Library.release();
 }

}
```

How to generate barcode

```java
import android.graphics.Bitmap;

import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Barcode;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Image;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.uiextensions.utils.AppFileUtil;

public class TestCase {

 public void testUint() {
 Library.initialize("sn", "key");
 barcode_GenerateAll();
 Library.release();
 }

 void save2Image(Bitmap bitmap, String bmp_name) {
 // Add the bitmap to image and save the image.
 try {
 Image image = new Image();
 image.addFrame(bitmap);
 image.saveAs(AppFileUtil.getSDPath() + "/GSDK3_0/Output/test"+bmp_name);
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 }

 void barcode_GenerateEachType(String code_string, int code_format, int unit_width, int unit_height, int qr_level, String bmp_name) {
 try {
 Barcode barcode = new Barcode();
 Bitmap bitmap = barcode.generateBitmap(code_string, code_format, unit_width, unit_height, qr_level);

 save2Image(bitmap, bmp_name);
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 }

 void barcode_GenerateAll() {
 // Strings used as barcode content.
 String[] sz_code_string = {"TEST-SHEET", "102030405060708090", "80674313", "890444000335", "9780804816632", "070429", "Unknown - change me!", "TestForBarcodeQrCode"};
 // Barcode format types
 int[] code_format = {Barcode.e_FormatCode39, Barcode.e_FormatCode128, Barcode.e_FormatEAN8, Barcode.e_FormatUPCA, Barcode.e_FormatEAN13, Barcode.e_FormatITF, Barcode.e_FormatPDF417, Barcode.e_FormatQRCode};

 // Image names for the saved image files.(except QR code)
 String[] sz_bmp_name = {"/code39_TEST-SHEET.bmp", "/CODE_128_102030405060708090.bmp", "/EAN_8_80674313.bmp", "/UPC_A_890444000335.bmp", "/EAN_13_9780804816632.bmp", "/ITF_070429.bmp", "/PDF_417_Unknown.bmp"};

 //Format error correction leveof QR code.
 int[] sz_qr_level = {Barcode.e_QRCorrectionLevelLow, Barcode.e_QRCorrectionLevelMedium, Barcode.e_QRCorrectionLevelQuater, Barcode.e_QRCorrectionLevelHigh};
 //Image names for the saved image files for QR code.
 String[] bmp_qr_name = {"/QR_CODE_TestForBarcodeQrCode_L.bmp", "/QR_CODE_TestForBarcodeQrCode_M.bmp", "/QR_CODE_TestForBarcodeQrCode_Q.bmp", "/QR_CODE_TestForBarcodeQrCode_H.bmp"};

 // Unit width for barcode in pixels, preferred value is 1-5 pixels.
 int unit_width = 2;
 // Unit height for barcode in pixels, preferred value is >= 20 pixels.
 int unit_height = 120;

 // Generate barcode for different types.
 for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
 if (code_format[i] != Barcode.e_FormatQRCode) {
 // Not QR code
 barcode_GenerateEachType(sz_code_string[i], code_format[i], unit_width, unit_height, Barcode.e_QRCorrectionLevelLow, sz_bmp_name[i]);
 } else {
 // QR code
 //Generate for each format error correction level.
 for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++)
 barcode_GenerateEachType(sz_code_string[i], code_format[i], unit_width, unit_height, sz_qr_level[j], bmp_qr_name[j]);
 }
 }
 }

}
```

how to add a single watermark

import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.Watermark;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.WatermarkSettings;

import java.io.File;

import static com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants.e_ErrSuccess;
import static com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage.e_ParsePageNormal;
import static com.foxit.sdk.pdf.WatermarkSettings.e_FlagASPageContents;
import static com.foxit.sdk.pdf.WatermarkSettings.e_FlagOnTop;

public class watermark {
 private final static String key = " ";
 private final static String sn = " ";

 static void addSingleWatermark(PDFDoc doc, PDFPage page) throws PDFException {
 WatermarkSettings settings = new WatermarkSettings();
 settings.setFlags(e_FlagASPageContents | e_FlagOnTop);
 settings.setOffset_x(0.f);
 settings.setOffset_y(0.f);
 settings.setOpacity(90);
 settings.setPosition(Constants.e_PosBottomRight);
 settings.setRotation(0.0f);
 settings.setScale_x(0.1f);
 settings.setScale_y(0.1f);

 Watermark watermark = new Watermark(doc, page, settings);
 watermark.insertToPage(page);
 }

 public static void main(String[] args) throws PDFException {
 File myPath = new File("../output_files/watermark/");
 // Initialize library
 int error_code = Library.initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != e_ErrSuccess) {
 return;
 }
 {
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("AboutFoxit.pdf");
 error_code = doc.load(null);

 if (error_code != e_ErrSuccess) {
 return;
 }
 int nCount = doc.getPageCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < nCount; i++) {
 PDFPage page = doc.getPage(i);
 page.startParse(e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);

 addSingleWatermark(doc, page);
 }
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}

---

How to disabled the form fields in PDF form files with Foxit PDF SDK for Android?

By default, highlighting form fields in PDF documents is enabled. If you want to disable it or to set
the highlight color, you can do it in the configuration JSON file (only support for version 6.3 or
higher) or by calling the APIs.

* Through JSON file (samples\complete_pdf_viewer\app\src\main\res\raw\uiextensions_config.json)
```java
 "highlightForm": false, //to disable highlighting the form fields in PDF document
```

* Through calling API
 __UIExtensionsManager.enableFormHighlight()__ interface is provided to set whether to enable
 highlighting the form fields in PDF form files. If you do not want to highlight form fields, please set
 the parameter to "false" as follows:
```java
 uiExtensionsManager.enableFormHighlight(false);
```

How to add a stamp annotation

```java
import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.fxcrt.RectF;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.annots.Annot;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.annots.Stamp;

class TestCase {

 public void testUint() {
 Library.initialize("sn", "key");
 try {
 //load document
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("sample.pdf");
 int error_code = doc.load(null);
 if (error_code != Constants.e_ErrSuccess) return;

 PDFPage page = doc.getPage(0);

 // Add common stamp annotation.
 Annot annot = page.addAnnot(Annot.e_Stamp, new RectF(110,150,200,250));
 Stamp stamp = new Stamp(annot);
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 stamp.setFlags(Annot.e_FlagPrint);
 stamp.setIconName("Approved");
 // Appearance should be reset.
 stamp.resetAppearanceStream();
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}
```

how to remove all watermark

import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage;

import java.io.File;

import static com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants.e_ErrSuccess;
import static com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage.e_ParsePageNormal;

public class watermark {
 private final static String key = " ";
 private final static String sn = " ";

 public static void main(String[] args) throws PDFException {
 File myPath = new File("../output_files/watermark/");
 // Initialize library
 int error_code = Library.initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != e_ErrSuccess) {
 return ;
 }
 {
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("AboutFoxit.pdf");
 error_code = doc.load(null);

 if (error_code != e_ErrSuccess) {
 return;
 }
 int nCount = doc.getPageCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < nCount; i++)
 {
 PDFPage page = doc.getPage(i);
 page.startParse(e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);
 if (page.hasWatermark()) {
 page.removeAllWatermarks();
 }
 }
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}

How to get all the layer nodes information

import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.LayerNode;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.LayerPrintData;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.LayerTree;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.LayerZoomData;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;

import java.io.FileWriter;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.Locale;

import static com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants.e_ErrSuccess;
import static com.foxit.sdk.pdf.LayerTree.e_StateON;

public class Pdflayer {
 static String key = " ";
 static String sn = " ";

 static void getAllLayerNodesInformation(LayerNode layer_node, int depth, FileWriter text_doc) throws PDFException, IOException {

 if (depth >= 0) {
 text_doc.write(String.format("%s", layer_node.getName()));

 if (layer_node.hasLayer()) {
 int state = layer_node.getViewUsage();
 text_doc.write(String.format(" %s\r\n", state == e_StateON ? "[*]" : "[ ]"));
 text_doc.write(String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "View usage state:\t%d\r\n", state));
 text_doc.write(String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "Export usage state:\t%d\r\n", layer_node.getExportUsage()));

 LayerPrintData print_data = layer_node.getPrintUsage();
 text_doc.write(String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "Print usage state:\t%d, subtype: %s\r\n", print_data.getPrint_state(), print_data.getSubtype()));

 LayerZoomData zoom_data = layer_node.getZoomUsage();
 text_doc.write(String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "Zomm usage:\tmin_factor = %.4f max_factor = %.4f\r\n\r\n", zoom_data.getMin_factor(), zoom_data.getMax_factor()));
 } else {
 text_doc.write("\r\n");
 }
 }
 }

 public static void main(String[] args) throws PDFException {
 // Initialize library
 int error_code = Library.initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != e_ErrSuccess) {
 return;
 }
 {
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("OCTest_src.pdf");
 error_code = doc.load(null);
 LayerTree layertree = new LayerTree(doc);
 LayerNode root = layertree.getRootNode();

 // Get original information of all layer nodes.
 String file_info = "original_layer_informations.txt";
 FileWriter create_info = null;
 try {
 create_info = new FileWriter(file_info, false);
 getAllLayerNodesInformation(root, -1, create_info);
 } catch (IOException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 } finally {
 if (create_info != null) {
 try {
 create_info.close();
 } catch (IOException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 }
 }
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}

how to add header footer

import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.fxcrt.RectF;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.HeaderFooter;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PageNumberRange;

import static com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants.e_ErrSuccess;
import static com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal;

public class Pdfheaderfooter {
 static String key = " ";
 static String sn = " ";

 public static void main(String[] args) throws PDFException {
 // Initialize library
 int error_code = Library.initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != e_ErrSuccess) {
 return;
 }
 {
 PDFDoc pdfDoc = new PDFDoc("inputPath");
 pdfDoc.load(null);

 HeaderFooter headerfooter = pdfDoc.getEditableHeaderFooter();
 // Add header-footer
 headerfooter.setText_color(0x00FFFF);
 headerfooter.setPage_range(new PageNumberRange(1, pdfDoc.getPageCount(), com.foxit.sdk.common.Range.e_Odd));
 headerfooter.setHas_fixedsize_for_print(false);
 headerfooter.setHas_text_shrinked(false);
 headerfooter.setStart_page_number(2);
 headerfooter.setPage_margin(new RectF(36, 70, 36, 70));
 headerfooter.setText_size(8);
 pdfDoc.addHeaderFooter(headerfooter);
 String output_file = "HeaderFooter_AddHeaderFooter.pdf";
 pdfDoc.saveAs(output_file, e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}

How to create a root node for bookmark?

```java
import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.Bookmark;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.actions.Destination;

import java.util.Locale;

public class TestCase {

 public void testUint() {
 Library.initialize("sn", "key");
 try {
 //load document
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("AboutFoxit.pdf");
 int error_code = doc.load(null);
 if (error_code != Constants.e_ErrSuccess) return;

 Bookmark root = doc.getRootBookmark();
 if (root.isEmpty())
 root = doc.createRootBookmark();
 for (int i = 0; i < doc.getPageCount(); i += 2) {
 Destination dest = Destination.createFitPage(doc, i);
 String ws_title = String.format(Locale.getDefault(),"A bookmark to a page (index: %d)", i);

 Bookmark child = root.insert(ws_title, Bookmark.e_PosLastChild);
 child.setDestination(dest);
 child.setColor(i * 0xF68C21);
 }

 // Save PDF file
 String newPdf = "bookmark_add.pdf";
 doc.saveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}
```

How to get associate files in page dictionary ?

```java
import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.AssociatedFiles;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.FileSpec;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.objects.PDFDictionary;

class TestCase {

 public void testUint() {
 Library.initialize("sn", "key");
 try {
 //load document
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("sample.pdf");
 int error_code = doc.load(null);
 if (error_code != Constants.e_ErrSuccess) return;

 AssociatedFiles associated_files = new AssociatedFiles(doc);

 PDFPage page = doc.getPage(0);
 PDFDictionary page_dict = page.getDict();
 associated_files.getAssociatedFilesCount(page_dict);
 FileSpec filespec = associated_files.getAssociatedFile(page_dict, 0);
 filespec.exportToFile("af_2.txt");
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}
```

How to export attachment file?

```java
import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.Attachments;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.FileSpec;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.objects.PDFNameTree;

class TestCase {

 public void testUint() {
 Library.initialize("sn", "key");
 try {
 //load document
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("sample.pdf");
 int error_code = doc.load(null);
 if (error_code != Constants.e_ErrSuccess) return;

 // Get information of attachments.
 Attachments attachments = new Attachments(doc,new PDFNameTree());
 int count = attachments.getCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
 String key = attachments.getKey(i);
 FileSpec file_spec = attachments.getEmbeddedFile(key);
 if (file_spec!= null && !file_spec.isEmpty()) {
 String name = file_spec.getFileName();

 if (file_spec.isEmbedded())
 file_spec.exportToFile(name);
 }
 }
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}
```

How to support chromebook with Foxit PDF SDK for Android

Foxit PDF SDK for Android support Chromebook. You should custom Application and extend `FoxitApplication` class,
the add `android:name="com.foxit.uiextensions.FoxitApplication"` to the __AndroidManifest.xml__ file.
```java
public class CustomApplication extends FoxitApplication {
}
```

`AndroidManifest.xml`
```java
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"
 ...>
 <application
 ...
 android:name="com.xxx.CustomApplication">
 ...
 </application>
</manifest>
```
