How to add a underline annotation

```java
import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.DateTime;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.fxcrt.PointF;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.fxcrt.RectF;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.annots.Annot;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.annots.QuadPoints;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.annots.QuadPointsArray;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.annots.Underline;

class TestCase {

 public void testUint() {
 Library.initialize("sn", "key");
 try {
 //load document
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("sample.pdf");
 int error_code = doc.load(null);
 if (error_code != Constants.e_ErrSuccess) return;

 PDFPage page = doc.getPage(0);

 // Add underline annotation
 Annot annot = page.addAnnot(Annot.e_Underline, new RectF(100,450,200,550));
 Underline underline = new Underline(annot);
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 underline.setFlags(Annot.e_FlagPrint);
 underline.setContent("Underline");
 QuadPoints quad_points = new QuadPoints();
 quad_points.setFirst(new PointF(110, 500));
 quad_points.setSecond(new PointF(190, 500));
 quad_points.setThird(new PointF(110, 480));
 quad_points.setFourth(new PointF(190, 480));
 QuadPointsArray quad_points_array = new QuadPointsArray();
 quad_points_array.add(quad_points);
 underline.setQuadPoints(quad_points_array);
 underline.setSubject("Underline");
 underline.setTitle("Foxit SDK");
 underline.setCreationDateTime(DateTime.getLocalTime());
 underline.setModifiedDateTime(DateTime.getLocalTime());

 // Appearance should be reset.
 underline.resetAppearanceStream();

 // Save PDF file
 String newPdf = "newpdf.pdf";
 doc.saveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}

```

---

About UIExtensionsManager introduction

1. It's not a singleton
2. Currently it contains the following interfaces：
2.1 IDocModifiedEventListener
```code
 /**
 * The interface for document modified event listener.
 */
 public interface IDocModifiedEventListener {
 /**
 * Triggered when the document is modified.
 *
 * @param doc A <CODE>PDFDoc</CODE> object which is modified.
 */
 void onDocModified(PDFDoc doc);
 }
```
2.2 OnFinishListener
```code
 /**
 * Interface used to allow the user to run some code
 * when close document and exit the current activity
 */
 public interface OnFinishListener {
 /**
 * Usually called when close document and exit the current activity.
 */
 void onFinish();
 }
```
2.3 ILinkEventListener
```code
 /**
 * Interface used to allow the user to run some code when do some operations on link
 */
 public interface ILinkEventListener {
 /**
 * Called when tap a link.
 *
 * @param linkInfo The link information of the tapped link.
 * @return Return <code>true</code> to prevent this event from being propagated
 * further, or <code>false</code> to indicate that you have not handled
 * this event and it should continue to be propagated by Foxit.
 */
 boolean onLinkTapped(LinkInfo linkInfo);
 }
```
2.4 MenuEventListener
```code
 /**
 * Interface used to allow the user to run some code
 * when do some operations on menu
 */
 public interface MenuEventListener {
 /**
 * Called when {@link #triggerDismissMenuEvent()} is called.
 */
 void onTriggerDismissMenu();
 }
```
2.5 ConfigurationChangedListener
```code
 /**
 * Interface used to allow the user to run some code
 * when the device configuration changes
 */
 public interface ConfigurationChangedListener {
 /**
 * Called when {@link UIExtensionsManager#onConfigurationChanged(Activity, Configuration)} is called.
 *
 * @param newConfig The new device configuration.
 */
 void onConfigurationChanged(Configuration newConfig);
 }
```
2.6 ToolHandlerChangedListener
```code
 /**
 * Interface used to allow the user to run some code
 * when the current {@link ToolHandler} has changed.
 */
 public interface ToolHandlerChangedListener {
 /**
 * Called when current {@link ToolHandler} has changed.
 *
 * @param oldToolHandler The old tool handler.
 * @param newToolHandler The new tool handler.
 */
 void onToolHandlerChanged(ToolHandler oldToolHandler, ToolHandler newToolHandler);
 }
```

How to remove all annotations

```java
import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage;

class TestCase {

 public void testUint() {
 Library.initialize("sn", "key");
 try {
 //load document
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("sample.pdf");
 int error_code = doc.load(null);
 if (error_code != Constants.e_ErrSuccess) return;

 PDFPage page = doc.getPage(0);
 int annotation_count = page.getAnnotCount();
 for (int i = annotation_count - 1; i >=0; i--)
 page.removeAnnot(page.getAnnot(i));

 // Save PDF file
 String newPdf = "newpdf.pdf";
 doc.saveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 Library.release();
 }

}

```

如何删除相机图标(android, complete_pdf_viewer)

Foxit PDF SDK for Android 提供的`samples/complete_pdf_viewer`中，初始界面的右下角有个相机图标， 点击这个图片， 进入的就是Scan功能。

## 仅移除相机图标

*com.foxit.home.HomeFragment#onCreateView()*
与 `mIvScan` 相关的都注释掉
```java
 ...
 //mIvScan.setLayoutParams(layoutParams);
 //mRootView.addView(mIvScan);
 ...
```

## 去掉Scan功能

如果还想将Scan功能里彻底移除的话, 包中`/docs/developer_guide_android.pdf`文档里，有教如何将加入Scan功能：
* `3.2 Integrate Foxit PDF SDK for Android into your apps`
* `3.7 Add the scanning feature based on the full-featured PDF Reader`

可以参考这部分说明，并将相关的库和代码都去掉，就能从`samples/complete_pdf_viewer`里去掉Scan功能了。

How to render layer node

import android.text.TextUtils;
import android.util.Log;

import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Progressive;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Renderer;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.fxcrt.Matrix2D;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.LayerContext;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.LayerNode;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.LayerTree;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;

import static com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants.e_ErrSuccess;
import static com.foxit.sdk.pdf.LayerContext.e_UsageView;

public class Pdflayer {
 static String key = " ";
 static String sn = " ";

 static void setAllLayerNodesVisible(LayerContext context, LayerNode layer_node, boolean visible) throws PDFException {
 if (layer_node.hasLayer()) {
 context.setVisible(layer_node, false);
 }
 int count = layer_node.getChildrenCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
 LayerNode child = layer_node.getChild(i);
 setAllLayerNodesVisible(context, child, visible);
 }
 }

 static void renderAllLayerNodes(PDFDoc doc, LayerContext context, LayerNode layer_node) throws PDFException {
 if (layer_node.hasLayer()) {
 context.setVisible(layer_node, true);
 int nCount = doc.getPageCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < nCount; i++) {
 PDFPage page = doc.getPage(i);
 String s = String.format("%d", i);
 String layer_name = layer_node.getName();
 layer_name = layer_name.replace(":", "");
 layer_name = layer_name.replace(">", "");
 layer_name = layer_name.replace("<", "");
 layer_name = layer_name.replace("=", "");
 String file_name = output_path + "page_" + s + "_layer_node_" + layer_name + ".bmp";
 renderPageToImage(page, file_name);
 }
 }

 int count = layer_node.getChildrenCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
 LayerNode child = layer_node.getChild(i);
 renderAllLayerNodes(doc, context, child);
 }
 if (layer_node.hasLayer()) {
 // The visibility of parent layer will affect the children layers,
 // so reset the visibility of parent layer after children have been rendered.
 context.setVisible(layer_node, false);
 }
 }

 static void renderPageToImage(PDFPage pdfPage, String path) {
 try {
 Progressive progressive = pdfPage.startParse(PDFPage.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);
 int state = Progressive.e_ToBeContinued;
 while (state == Progressive.e_ToBeContinued) {
 state = progressive.resume();
 }

 float width = pdfPage.getWidth();
 float height = pdfPage.getHeight();
 android.graphics.Bitmap bitmap = android.graphics.Bitmap.createBitmap((int) width, (int) height, android.graphics.Bitmap.Config.RGB_565);
 bitmap.eraseColor(android.graphics.Color.WHITE);
 Matrix2D matrix = pdfPage.getDisplayMatrix(0, 0, (int) width, (int) height, Constants.e_Rotation0);
 Renderer renderer = new Renderer(bitmap, true);
// renderer.setRenderAnnotsForThumbnail(true);
 renderer.setRenderContentFlags(Renderer.e_RenderPage | Renderer.e_RenderAnnot);

 Progressive progressive2 = renderer.startRender(pdfPage, matrix, null);
 int state2 = Progressive.e_ToBeContinued;
 while (state2 == Progressive.e_ToBeContinued) {
 state2 = progressive2.resume();
 }

 if (!TextUtils.isEmpty(path)) {
 saveBitmap(bitmap, path);
 }
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 Log.i("mytag", "renderPage:" + e.getLastError());
 }

 }

 static void saveBitmap(android.graphics.Bitmap bm, String outPath) {
 File file = new File(outPath);
 try {
 file.createNewFile();
 FileOutputStream fileout = null;
 fileout = new FileOutputStream(file);
 bm.compress(android.graphics.Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 100, fileout);
 fileout.flush();
 fileout.close();
 } catch (IOException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 }

 public static void main(String[] args) throws PDFException {
 File myPath = new File( "../output_files/pdflayer/");
 // Initialize library
 int error_code = Library.initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != e_ErrSuccess) {
 return;
 }
 {
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("OCTest_src.pdf");
 error_code = doc.load(null);
 LayerTree layertree = new LayerTree(doc);
 LayerNode root = layertree.getRootNode();

 LayerContext context = new LayerContext(doc, e_UsageView);
 setAllLayerNodesVisible(context, root, false);
 renderAllLayerNodes(doc, context, root);
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}

---

How to modify theme color

Use `ThemeConfig.getInstance(context).primaryColor(new_color)` to modify the theme color

The default theme color of RDK is (0xffA236B2)：

```code
import com.foxit.uiextensions.theme.ThemeConfig;

// Value format for "new_color" should be 0xaarrggbb.If use 0xrrggbb, that means 0xFFrrggbb.
ThemeConfig.getInstance(getApplicationContext()).primaryColor(new_color);
```

Note：
* ThemeConfig is not exported to API reference.
* The color format is 0xaarrggbb, if only 0xrrggbb is written, the alpha channel is FF.
* After this method is executed, the theme color will change. It is recommended to call when the app is initialized or initially created.

e.g.
```code
new_color = Color.LTGRAY (0xFFCCCCCC)
ThemeConfig.getInstance(getApplicationContext()).primaryColor(new_color);
```

How to create a reflow page and render it to a bmp file

import android.graphics.Color;

import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Renderer;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.fxcrt.Matrix2D;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.fxcrt.PointF;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.fxcrt.RectF;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.ReflowPage;

import java.io.File;

import static com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants.e_ErrSuccess;
import static com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants.e_Rotation0;
import static com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage.e_ParsePageNormal;
import static com.foxit.sdk.pdf.ReflowPage.e_WithImage;

public class PDFReflow {
 private final static String key = " ";
 private final static String sn = " ";

 static String input_file = " ";
 static String output_path = " ";

 // Fixed bitmap size, just to simulate split screen situation.
 public static void ReflowContinuous(PDFDoc doc) throws PDFException {
 RectF margin = new RectF(50, 30, 30, 30);
 PointF size = new PointF(480, 800);

 android.graphics.Bitmap bitmap = android.graphics.Bitmap.createBitmap((int) (size.getX()), (int) (size.getY()), android.graphics.Bitmap.Config.RGB_565);
 bitmap.eraseColor(Color.WHITE);

 float offset_y = 0;
 int nCount = doc.getPageCount();

 int bitmap_index = 0;

 for (int i = 0; i < nCount; i++) {
 PDFPage page = doc.getPage(i);
 page.startParse(e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);
 ReflowPage reflow_page = new ReflowPage(page);
 // Set some arguments used for parsing the relfow page.
 reflow_page.setLineSpace(0);
 reflow_page.setScreenMargin((int) (margin.getLeft()), (int) (margin.getTop()),
 (int) (margin.getRight()), (int) (margin.getBottom()));
 reflow_page.setScreenSize(size.getX(), size.getY());
 reflow_page.setZoom(100);
 reflow_page.setParseFlags(e_WithImage);

 reflow_page.setTopSpace(offset_y);
 // Parse reflow page.
 reflow_page.startParse(null);
 // Get actual size of content of reflow page.
 // The content size does not contain the margin but contains the top space.
 float content_height = reflow_page.getContentHeight();
 float content_width = reflow_page.getContentWidth();
 // Render reflow page.
 Renderer renderer = new Renderer(bitmap, false);
 Matrix2D matrix = reflow_page.getDisplayMatrix(0, 0, (int) content_width, (int) content_height, e_Rotation0);
 renderer.startRenderReflowPage(reflow_page, matrix, null);

 }

 }

 public static void main(String[] args) throws PDFException {
 File myPath = new File(output_path);
 // Initialize library
 int error_code = Library.initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != e_ErrSuccess) {
 return;
 }
 {
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("AboutFoxit.pdf");
 error_code = doc.load(null);
 if (error_code != e_ErrSuccess) {
 System.out.println("The Doc " + "AboutFoxit.pdf" + " Error: " + error_code);
 return;
 }
 ReflowContinuous(doc);
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}

How to add a "file attachment" annotation

```java
import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.DateTime;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.fxcrt.RectF;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.FileSpec;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.annots.Annot;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.annots.FileAttachment;

class TestCase {

 public void testUint() {
 Library.initialize("sn", "key");
 try {
 //load document
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("sample.pdf");
 int error_code = doc.load(null);
 if (error_code != Constants.e_ErrSuccess) return;

 PDFPage page = doc.getPage(0);

 // Add file attachment annotation
 Annot annot = page.addAnnot(Annot.e_FileAttachment, new RectF(280,350,300,380));
 FileAttachment file_attachment = new FileAttachment(annot);
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 file_attachment.setFlags(4);
 file_attachment.setIconName("Graph");

 FileSpec file_spec = new FileSpec(page.getDocument());
 file_spec.setFileName("attachment.pdf");
 file_spec.setCreationDateTime(DateTime.getLocalTime());
 file_spec.setDescription("The original file");
 file_spec.setModifiedDateTime(DateTime.getLocalTime());
 file_spec.embed(pdf_file);
 file_attachment.setFileSpec(file_spec);
 file_attachment.setSubject("File Attachment");
 file_attachment.setTitle("Foxit SDK");
 // Appearance should be reset.
 file_attachment.resetAppearanceStream();

 // Save PDF file
 String newPdf = "newpdf.pdf";
 doc.saveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}

```

How to get all annotations in all pages?

```java
import android.util.Log;

import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;

 try {
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("sample.pdf");
 int error_code = doc.load(null);
 if (error_code == Constants.e_ErrSuccess) {
 int page_count = doc.getPageCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < page_count; i++) {
 PDFPage page = doc.getPage(i);
 int annot_count = page.getAnnotCount();
 for (int j = 0; j < annot_count; j++) {

 Log.i("tag","annotType:" + annot.getType());
 }
 }
 }
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();

 Library.release();
 }
}
```

how to set the highlight color of form fields with Foxit PDF SDK for Android

By default, highlighting form fields in PDF documents is enabled. If you want to disable it or to set
the highlight color, you can do it in the configuration JSON file (only support for version 6.3 or
higher) or by calling the APIs.

* Through JSON file (samples\complete_pdf_viewer\app\src\main\res\raw\uiextensions_config.json)

__Note:__ If you want to set the highlight color, please make sure the highlighting form fields feature is
enabled
```java
 "highlightForm": true, // to disable highlighting the form fields in PDF document.
 "highlightFormColor": "#2000ffcc" // to set the highlight color (input the color value as you
wish).
```

* Through calling API
 __UIExtensionsManager.setFormHighlightColor()__ interface is used to set the highlight color.
 Following is a sample for calling this API:
```java
 uiExtensionsManager.enableFormHighlight(true);
 uiExtensionsManager.setFormHighlightColor(0x4b0000ff);
```

How to get associate files in annotation dictionary ?

```java
import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.AssociatedFiles;

import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.annots.Annot;

class TestCase {

 public void testUint() {
 Library.initialize("sn", "key");
 try {
 //load document
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("sample.pdf");
 int error_code = doc.load(null);
 if (error_code != Constants.e_ErrSuccess) return;

 AssociatedFiles associated_files = new AssociatedFiles(doc);

 PDFPage page = doc.getPage(0);
 Annot annot = page.getAnnot(0);
 PDFDictionary annot_dict = annot.getDict();
 associated_files.getAssociatedFilesCount(annot_dict);
 FileSpec filespec = associated_files.getAssociatedFile(annot_dict, 0);
 filespec.exportToFile("af_4.txt");
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}
```

---

How to render layer node

import android.text.TextUtils;
import android.util.Log;

import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Progressive;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Renderer;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.fxcrt.Matrix2D;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.LayerContext;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.LayerNode;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.LayerTree;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.FileOutputStream;
import java.io.IOException;

import static com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants.e_ErrSuccess;
import static com.foxit.sdk.pdf.LayerContext.e_UsageView;

public class Pdflayer {
 static String key = " ";
 static String sn = " ";

 static void setAllLayerNodesVisible(LayerContext context, LayerNode layer_node, boolean visible) throws PDFException {
 if (layer_node.hasLayer()) {
 context.setVisible(layer_node, false);
 }
 int count = layer_node.getChildrenCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
 LayerNode child = layer_node.getChild(i);
 setAllLayerNodesVisible(context, child, visible);
 }
 }

 static void renderAllLayerNodes(PDFDoc doc, LayerContext context, LayerNode layer_node) throws PDFException {
 if (layer_node.hasLayer()) {
 context.setVisible(layer_node, true);
 int nCount = doc.getPageCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < nCount; i++) {
 PDFPage page = doc.getPage(i);
 String s = String.format("%d", i);
 String layer_name = layer_node.getName();
 layer_name = layer_name.replace(":", "");
 layer_name = layer_name.replace(">", "");
 layer_name = layer_name.replace("<", "");
 layer_name = layer_name.replace("=", "");
 String file_name = output_path + "page_" + s + "_layer_node_" + layer_name + ".bmp";
 renderPageToImage(page, file_name);
 }
 }

 int count = layer_node.getChildrenCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
 LayerNode child = layer_node.getChild(i);
 renderAllLayerNodes(doc, context, child);
 }
 if (layer_node.hasLayer()) {
 context.setVisible(layer_node, false);
 }
 }

 static void renderPageToImage(PDFPage pdfPage, String path) {
 try {
 Progressive progressive = pdfPage.startParse(PDFPage.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);
 int state = Progressive.e_ToBeContinued;
 while (state == Progressive.e_ToBeContinued) {
 state = progressive.resume();
 }

 float width = pdfPage.getWidth();
 float height = pdfPage.getHeight();
 android.graphics.Bitmap bitmap = android.graphics.Bitmap.createBitmap((int) width, (int) height, android.graphics.Bitmap.Config.RGB_565);
 bitmap.eraseColor(android.graphics.Color.WHITE);
 Matrix2D matrix = pdfPage.getDisplayMatrix(0, 0, (int) width, (int) height, Constants.e_Rotation0);
 Renderer renderer = new Renderer(bitmap, true);
// renderer.setRenderAnnotsForThumbnail(true);
 renderer.setRenderContentFlags(Renderer.e_RenderPage | Renderer.e_RenderAnnot);

 Progressive progressive2 = renderer.startRender(pdfPage, matrix, null);
 int state2 = Progressive.e_ToBeContinued;
 while (state2 == Progressive.e_ToBeContinued) {
 state2 = progressive2.resume();
 }

 if (!TextUtils.isEmpty(path)) {
 saveBitmap(bitmap, path);
 }
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 Log.i("mytag", "renderPage:" + e.getLastError());
 }

 }

 static void saveBitmap(android.graphics.Bitmap bm, String outPath) {
 File file = new File(outPath);
 try {
 file.createNewFile();
 FileOutputStream fileout = null;
 fileout = new FileOutputStream(file);
 bm.compress(android.graphics.Bitmap.CompressFormat.JPEG, 100, fileout);
 fileout.flush();
 fileout.close();
 } catch (IOException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 }

 public static void main(String[] args) throws PDFException {
 // Initialize library
 int error_code = Library.initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != e_ErrSuccess) {
 return;
 }
 {
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("OCTest_src.pdf");
 error_code = doc.load(null);
 LayerTree layertree = new LayerTree(doc);
 LayerNode root = layertree.getRootNode();

 LayerContext context = new LayerContext(doc, e_UsageView);
 setAllLayerNodesVisible(context, root, false);
 renderAllLayerNodes(doc, context, root);
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}

How to associate file to FormX object?

```java
import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.DateTime;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.AssociatedFiles;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.FileSpec;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.graphics.FormXObject;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.graphics.GraphicsObject;

class TestCase {

 public void testUint() {

 Library.initialize("sn", "key");
 try {
 //load document
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("sample.pdf");
 int error_code = doc.load(null);
 if (error_code != Constants.e_ErrSuccess) return;

 AssociatedFiles associated_files = new AssociatedFiles(doc);
 FileSpec filespec_jpg = new FileSpec(doc);
 filespec_jpg.setAssociteFileRelationship(AssociatedFiles.e_RelationshipSource);
 filespec_jpg.setFileName("2.jpg");
 filespec_jpg.setDescription("jpeg");
 filespec_jpg.embed("2.jpg");
 DateTime dateTime = new DateTime(2017, 9, 15, 17, 20, 20, 0, (short) 8, 0);
 filespec_jpg.setCreationDateTime(dateTime);
 filespec_jpg.setModifiedDateTime(dateTime);
 filespec_jpg.setSubtype("application/octet-stream");

 PDFPage page = doc.getPage(0);
 page.startParse(PDFPage.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);
 long position = page.getFirstGraphicsObjectPosition(GraphicsObject.e_TypeFormXObject);
 GraphicsObject graphics_object = page.getGraphicsObject(position);
 if (graphics_object != null) {
 FormXObject form_x_object = graphics_object.getFormXObject();
 if (form_x_object != null)
 associated_files.associateFile(form_x_object, filespec_jpg);
 }

 // Save PDF file
 String newPdf = "newpdf.pdf";
 doc.saveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}
```

How to get associate files in graphics objects?

```java
import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.AssociatedFiles;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.FileSpec;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.graphics.FormXObject;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.graphics.GraphicsObject;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.graphics.ImageObject;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.objects.PDFDictionary;

class TestCase {

 public void testUint() {
 Library.initialize("sn", "key");
 try {
 //load document
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("sample.pdf");
 int error_code = doc.load(null);
 if (error_code != Constants.e_ErrSuccess) return;

 AssociatedFiles associated_files = new AssociatedFiles(doc);

 PDFPage page = doc.getPage(0);
 page.startParse(PDFPage.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);

 long pos = page.getFirstGraphicsObjectPosition(GraphicsObject.e_TypeImage);
 GraphicsObject graphics_object = page.getGraphicsObject(pos);
 ImageObject imageObject = graphics_object.getImageObject();
 if (imageObject != null) {
 PDFDictionary image_x_object_dict = imageObject.getStream().getDict();
 int count = associated_files.getAssociatedFilesCount(image_x_object_dict);
 FileSpec filespec = associated_files.getAssociatedFile(image_x_object_dict, 0);
 filespec.exportToFile("af_5.txt");
 }

 pos = page.getFirstGraphicsObjectPosition(GraphicsObject.e_TypeFormXObject);
 FormXObject form_x_object = page.getGraphicsObject(pos).getFormXObject();
 if (form_x_object != null) {
 PDFDictionary form_x_object_dict = form_x_object.getStream().getDict();
 int count = associated_files.getAssociatedFilesCount(form_x_object_dict);
 FileSpec filespec = associated_files.getAssociatedFile(form_x_object_dict, 0);
 filespec.exportToFile("af_6.txt");
 }
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}
```

---

how to insert image with Foxit PDF SDK for Android?

There are many ways to insert pictures, three ways are introduced below.

1. The first one is calling `PDFPage#addImageFromFilePath` interface
```java
 private void addImageByPage(PDFDoc doc) throws PDFException {
 PDFPage pdf_page = doc.getPage(0);
 pdf_page.startParse(PDFPage.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);
 pdf_page.addImageFromFilePath("mnt/sdcard/input_files/2.png", new PointF(20, 30), 60, 50, true);
 // Save PDF file
 String newPdf = "addImageByPage.pdf";
 doc.saveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNormal);
 }
```

2. The second one is calling `Stamp#setBitmap` interface
```java
 private void addImageByStamp(PDFDoc doc) throws PDFException {
 PDFPage pdf_page = doc.getPage(0);
 pdf_page.startParse(PDFPage.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);

 Stamp stamp = new Stamp(pdf_page.addAnnot(Annot.e_Stamp, new RectF(100, 350, 250, 150)));
 // Load a local image and convert it to a Bitmap.
 Bitmap bitmap = BitmapFactory.decodeFile("mnt/sdcard/input_files/2.png");
// Set the bitmap to the added stamp annotation.
 stamp.setBitmap(bitmap);
 stamp.resetAppearanceStream();

 // Save PDF file
 String newPdf = "addImageByStamp.pdf";
 doc.saveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNormal);
 }
```
3. The third one is calling `Screen#setImage` interface
```java
 private void addImageByScreen(PDFDoc doc) throws PDFException {
 PDFPage pdf_page = doc.getPage(0);
 pdf_page.startParse(PDFPage.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);

 Screen screen = new Screen(pdf_page.addAnnot(Annot.e_Stamp, new RectF(100, 350, 250, 150)));
 // Load a local image and convert it to a Bitmap.
 Image image = new Image("mnt/sdcard/input_files/2.png");
 screen.setImage(image, 0, 0);
 screen.resetAppearanceStream();

 // Save PDF file
 String newPdf = "addImageByScreen.pdf";
 doc.saveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNormal);
 }
```

how to convert text to pdf

import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.addon.conversion.Convert;
import com.foxit.sdk.addon.conversion.TXT2PDFSettingData;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Font;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.fxcrt.RectF;

import static com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants.e_ErrSuccess;

public class text2pdf{
 private final static String key = " ";
 private final static String sn = " ";

 static String input_file = " ";
 static String output_file = " ";

 public static void main(String[] args) throws PDFException {
 // Initialize library
 int error_code = Library.initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != e_ErrSuccess) {
 return;
 }
 {
 TXT2PDFSettingData setting_data = new TXT2PDFSettingData();
 Font font = new Font("SimSun", Font.e_StyleFixedPitch, Font.e_CharsetGB2312, 0);
 setting_data.setPage_width(595);
 setting_data.setPage_height(842);
 setting_data.setFont(font);
 setting_data.setText_color(0xFF0000FF);
 setting_data.setText_size(9);
 setting_data.setLinespace(1);
 setting_data.setPage_margin(new RectF(0, 0, 0, 0));
 Convert.fromTXT(input_file, output_file, setting_data);

 }
 Library.release();
 }
}

How to set all the layer nodes information

import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.LayerNode;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.LayerPrintData;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.LayerTree;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.LayerZoomData;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;

import static com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants.e_ErrSuccess;
import static com.foxit.sdk.pdf.LayerTree.e_StateOFF;
import static com.foxit.sdk.pdf.LayerTree.e_StateON;
import static com.foxit.sdk.pdf.LayerTree.e_StateUndefined;

public class Pdflayer{
 static String key = " ";
 static String sn = " ";

 static void setAllLayerNodesInformation(LayerNode layer_node) throws PDFException {
 if (layer_node.hasLayer()) {
 layer_node.setDefaultVisible(true);
 layer_node.setExportUsage(e_StateUndefined);
 layer_node.setViewUsage(e_StateOFF);
 LayerPrintData print_data = new LayerPrintData("subtype_print", e_StateON);
 layer_node.setPrintUsage(print_data);
 LayerZoomData zoom_data = new LayerZoomData(1, 10);
 layer_node.setZoomUsage(zoom_data);
 String new_name = String.format("[View_OFF_Print_ON_Export_Undefined]") + layer_node.getName();
 layer_node.setName(new_name);
 }
 int count = layer_node.getChildrenCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
 LayerNode child = layer_node.getChild(i);
 setAllLayerNodesInformation(child);
 }
 }

 public static void main(String[] args) throws PDFException {
 // Initialize library
 int error_code = Library.initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != e_ErrSuccess) {
 return;
 }
 {
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("OCTest_src.pdf");
 error_code = doc.load(null);
 LayerTree layertree = new LayerTree(doc);
 LayerNode root = layertree.getRootNode();

 // Set new information.
 setAllLayerNodesInformation(root);
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}

How to add a highlight annotation

```java
import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.DateTime;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.fxcrt.PointF;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.fxcrt.RectF;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.annots.Annot;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.annots.Highlight;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.annots.QuadPoints;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.annots.QuadPointsArray;

class TestCase {

 public void testUint() {
 Library.initialize("sn", "key");
 try {
 //load document
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("sample.pdf");
 int error_code = doc.load(null);
 if (error_code != Constants.e_ErrSuccess) return;

 // Add highlight annotation.
 PDFPage page = doc.getPage(0);
 Annot annot = page.addAnnot(Annot.e_Highlight, new RectF(10,450,100,550));

 Highlight highlight = new Highlight(annot);
 //This flag is used for printing annotations.
 highlight.setFlags(Annot.e_FlagPrint);
 highlight.setContent("Highlight");
 QuadPoints quad_points = new QuadPoints();
 quad_points.setFirst(new PointF(10, 500));
 quad_points.setSecond(new PointF(90, 500));
 quad_points.setThird(new PointF(10, 480));
 quad_points.setFourth(new PointF(90, 480));
 QuadPointsArray quad_points_array = new QuadPointsArray();
 quad_points_array.add(quad_points);
 highlight.setQuadPoints(quad_points_array);
 highlight.setSubject("Highlight");
 highlight.setTitle("Foxit SDK");
 highlight.setCreationDateTime(DateTime.getLocalTime());
 highlight.setModifiedDateTime(DateTime.getLocalTime());

 // Appearance should be reset.
 highlight.resetAppearanceStream();

 // Save PDF file
 String newPdf = "newpdf.pdf";
 doc.saveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 Library.release();
 }

}
```

---

how to flatten a pdf

```java
import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage;

public class TestCase {

 public void testUint() {
 Library.initialize("sn", "key");
 try {
 //load document
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("sample.pdf");
 int error_code = doc.load(null);
 if (error_code != Constants.e_ErrSuccess) return;

 int pageCount = doc.getPageCount();
 // Flatten PDF pages.
 for (int i = 0; i < pageCount; i++) {
 PDFPage page = doc.getPage(i);
 // Parse page before flattening the page.
 page.startParse(PDFPage.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);
 // Flatten a PDF page without annotations
 page.flatten(true, PDFPage.e_FlattenAll);
 }
 // Save PDF file
 String newPdf = "newpdf.pdf";
 doc.saveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNormal);
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 } Library.release();
 }

}
```

how to export and import XFA form data

```java
import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.addon.xfa.XFADoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;

public class TestCase {
 private static final String TAG = TestCase.class.getSimpleName();

 public void testUint() {
 Library.initialize("sn", "key");
 try {
 //load document
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("AboutFoxit.pdf");
 int error_code = doc.load(null);
 if (error_code != Constants.e_ErrSuccess) return;

 XFADoc xfa_doc = new XFADoc(doc, null);
 xfa_doc.startLoad(null);

 xfa_doc.exportData("xfa_form.xml", XFADoc.e_ExportDataTypeXML);

 xfa_doc.resetForm();
 doc.saveAs("xfa_dynamic_resetform.pdf", PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNormal);

 xfa_doc.importData("xfa_form.xml");
 doc.saveAs("xfa_dynamic_importdata.pdf", PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNormal);
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}
```

---

如何切换工具 (android, java, UIExtensionsManager)

### 1.`com.foxit.uiextensions.UiExtensionsManager#setCurrentToolHandle` 来切换工具，如画笔

```java
ToolHandler toolHandler = mUiExtensionsManager.getToolHandlerByType(ToolHandler.TH_TYPE_INK);
mUiExtensionsManager.setCurrentToolHandler(toolHandler);
```
工具的名称可以参考 `com.foxit.uiextensions.ToolHandler`

### 2.可以通过 `com.foxit.uiextensions.UIExtensionsManager#changeState` 来切换不同的状态， 如 reflow

```java
uiExtensionsManager.changeState(ReadStateConfig.STATE_REFLOW);
```

目前主要有以下几种状态`com.foxit.uiextensions.pdfreader.config.ReadStateConfig`:
```java
public class ReadStateConfig {
 public static final int STATE_NORMAL = 1;
 public static final int STATE_REFLOW = 2;
 public static final int STATE_SEARCH = 3;
 public static final int STATE_PANZOOM = 4;
 public static final int STATE_COMPARE = 5;
 public static final int STATE_TTS = 6;
 public static final int STATE_FILLSIGN = 7;
 public static final int STATE_AUTOFLIP = 8;
 public static final int STATE_REDACT = 9;
}
```

### 3.可以通过 `samples/complete_pdf_viewer/app/src/main/res/raw/uiextensions_config.json` 来配置， 如 reflow

```java
{
 ...
 "uiSettings": {
 "pageMode": "Reflow",
 ...
 },
 ...
}
```

---

How to associate file to page dictionary?

```java
import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.DateTime;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.AssociatedFiles;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.FileSpec;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage;

class TestCase {

 public void testUint() {
 Library.initialize("sn", "key");
 try {
 //load document
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("sample.pdf");
 int error_code = doc.load(null);
 if (error_code != Constants.e_ErrSuccess) return;

 AssociatedFiles associated_files = new AssociatedFiles(doc);

 //Create filespec with 1.txt
 FileSpec filespec_txt =new FileSpec(doc);
 filespec_txt.setAssociteFileRelationship(AssociatedFiles.e_RelationshipSource);
 filespec_txt.setFileName("1.txt");
 DateTime dateTime = new DateTime(2023, 6, 8, 17, 20, 20, 0, (short) 8, 0);
 filespec_txt.setDescription("text");
 filespec_txt.embed("1.txt");
 filespec_txt.setCreationDateTime(dateTime);
 filespec_txt.setModifiedDateTime(dateTime);
 filespec_txt.setSubtype("application/octet-stream");

 PDFPage page = doc.getPage(0);
 page.startParse(PDFPage.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);
 associated_files.associateFile(page, filespec_txt);

 // Save PDF file
 String newPdf = "newpdf.pdf";
 doc.saveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal);
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}
```

---

```java
import android.graphics.Bitmap;
import android.graphics.Color;

import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Renderer;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.fxcrt.Matrix2D;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage;

class TestCase {

 public void testUint() {
 Library.initialize("sn", "key");
 try {
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc("sample.pdf");
 int error_code = doc.load(null);
 if (error_code != Constants.e_ErrSuccess) return;

 String[] support_image_extends = {".bmp", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".jpx", ".jp2"};

 int page_count = doc.getPageCount();
 for (int i = 0; i < page_count; i++) {
 PDFPage page = doc.getPage(i);
 page.startParse(PDFPage.e_ParsePageNormal, null, false);

 float width = page.getWidth();
 float height = page.getHeight();
 Matrix2D matrix = page.getDisplayMatrix(0, 0, (int) width, (int) height, page.getRotation());

 // Prepare a bitmap for rendering.
 Bitmap bitmap = Bitmap.createBitmap((int) width, (int) height, Bitmap.Config.RGB_565);
 bitmap.eraseColor(Color.WHITE);

 // Render page
 Renderer render = new Renderer(bitmap, true);
 render.startRender(page, matrix, null);
 }
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 Library.release();
 }

}
```

---

how to do some operation about PDF object

import android.os.Environment;
import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.objects.PDFDictionary;

import java.io.File;

import static com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants.e_ErrSuccess;
import static com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNoOriginal;

public class TestPDFObject {
 private final static String key = " ";
 private final static String sn = " ";

 static String input_file = " ";
 static String output_path = " ";

 // This function is to remove some properties from catalog dictionary.
 static void RemoveCatalogKey(PDFDoc document) throws PDFException {
 if (document.isEmpty()) {
 return;
 }

 PDFDictionary catalog = document.getCatalog();
 if (null == catalog) {
 return;
 }

 String[] key_strings = {"Type", "Boolean", "Name", "String", "Array", "Dict"};
 int count = key_strings.length;
 for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
 if (catalog.hasKey(key_strings[i])) {
 catalog.removeAt(key_strings[i]);
 }
 }
 }

 public static void main(String[] args) throws PDFException {
 File myPath = new File(output_path);
 // Initialize library
 int error_code = Library.initialize(sn, key);
 if (error_code != e_ErrSuccess) {
 return;
 }
 {
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc(input_file);
 doc.startLoad(null, false, null);

 // To remove some properties from catalog dictionary.
 RemoveCatalogKey(doc);
 String save_pdf_patth = Environment.getExternalStorageDirectory().getPath() + "/pdfobjects_removekeyfromcatalog.pdf";
 doc.startSaveAs(save_pdf_patth, e_SaveFlagNoOriginal, null);
 }
 Library.release();
 }
}

---

how to Add points to pressure sensitive ink.

```java
import com.foxit.sdk.PDFException;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Constants;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.Library;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.fxcrt.PointF;
import com.foxit.sdk.common.fxcrt.RectF;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFDoc;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PDFPage;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.PSI;
import com.foxit.sdk.pdf.annots.Annot;

public class TestCase {

 float[] kPointsData = {
 1, 121.3043f, 326.6846f, 0.0966f, 2, 121.1304f, 326.8709f, 0.1376f, 2, 121.1304f, 326.9641f, 0.1484f,
 2, 121.1304f, 327.0572f, 0.2226f, 2, 121.1304f, 327.2435f, 0.3203f, 2, 121.1304f, 327.5230f, 0.3916f,
 2, 121.4782f, 330.7833f, 0.7041f, 2, 122.0000f, 331.4354f, 0.7275f, 2, 122.9565f, 331.9943f, 0.7363f,
 2, 546.0869f, 402.0447f, 0.5322f, 3, 546.0869f, 402.0447f, 0.0000f };

 public void testUint() {
 Library.initialize("sn", "key");
 try {
 PSI psi = new PSI(480, 180, true);
 psi.setDiameter(9);
 psi.setColor(0x434236);
 psi.setOpacity(0.8f);

 // Add points to pressure sensitive ink.
 for (int i = 0; i < kPointsData.length; i += 4) {
 float x = kPointsData[i + 1] - 100.f;
 float y = kPointsData[i + 2] - 300.f;
 float pressure = kPointsData[i + 3];

 int type = (int) kPointsData[i];
 psi.addPoint(new PointF(x, y), type, pressure);
 }
 PDFDoc doc = new PDFDoc();
 PDFPage page = doc.insertPage(0, PDFPage.e_SizeLetter);

 // Convert PSI to PSInk annotation.
 float width = 480.f;
 float height = 180.f;
 RectF rect = new RectF(page.getWidth() / 2 - width / 2, page.getHeight() / 2 - height / 2,
 page.getWidth() / 2 + width / 2, page.getHeight() / 2 + height / 2);

 Annot annot = psi.convertToPDFAnnot(page, rect, Constants.e_Rotation0);

 // Save PDF file
 String newPdf = "pressure_sensitive_ink.pdf";
 doc.saveAs(newPdf, PDFDoc.e_SaveFlagNormal);
 } catch (PDFException e) {
 e.printStackTrace();
 }
 Library.release();
 }

}
```
